```{r sidebar_filters_parameters}
#| title: "Filters & Parameters"
```

---

**Data Provided By:** `r params$Company`

---

**Subject Property**

**Address:** `r params$SubAddress`, `r params$SubCity`, `r params$SubProvince`<br>
**Lot Size:** `r if(params$AcOrSF == "ac") paste0(params$SubLotAc, " acres") else paste0(format(params$SubLotSF, big.mark=","), " sf")`<br>
**Zoning:** `r params$SubZoning`<br>
**Effective Date:** `r params$EffDate`

---

**Parameters for Competitive Market Segment (CMS)**

**Sale Date Range:** `r format(as.Date(params$LoSaleDate), "%b %Y")` to `r format(as.Date(if (params$HiSaleDate == "") params$EffDate else params$HiSaleDate), "%b %Y")`<br>
**Size Range:** `r if(params$AcOrSF == "ac") paste0(params$LoLandSizeAc, "-", params$HiLandSizeAc, " acres") else paste0(format(params$LoLandSizeSF, big.mark=","), "-", format(params$HiLandSizeSF, big.mark=","), " sf")`<br>
**Distance:** `r params$LoDistKM` to `r params$HiDistKM` km from `r params$RefPoint`<br>
**Property Type:** `r if(length(params$PropMajorInc) > 0 && any(params$PropMajorInc != "")) paste(params$PropMajorInc, collapse=", ") else "All"`<br>
**Size Unit:** `r toupper(params$AcOrSF)`\
**Neighbourhoods Excluded:** `r if(length(params$NeighborhoodExcl) > 0 && any(params$NeighborhoodExcl != "")) paste(params$NeighborhoodExcl, collapse = ", ") else "None"`

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages and resolve HiSaleDate default from params.
options(scipen = 999)

# Load packages
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, dplyr, readr, ggtext, geosphere, mapgl, scales,
               plotly, patchwork, mapview, chromote, openxlsx, stringr,
               lubridate, glue, ggpubr, sf, magrittr, explore)

# ==============================================================================
# PARAMETER DEFAULTS: Fall back to EffDate if HiSaleDate is blank
# ==============================================================================
HiSaleDate <- if (is.null(params$HiSaleDate) || params$HiSaleDate == "") {
  params$EffDate
} else {
  params$HiSaleDate
}

# ==============================================================================
# SUBJECT DENSITY: Computed as round(SubLandUnits / SubLotAc).
# Used by the CMSLU density charts (vline + intersection caption).
# ==============================================================================
SubLandUnitDensity1 <- if (!is.null(params$SubLandUnits) &&
                           !is.null(params$SubLotAc) &&
                           is.numeric(params$SubLandUnits) &&
                           is.numeric(params$SubLotAc) &&
                           params$SubLotAc > 0) {
  round(params$SubLandUnits / params$SubLotAc)
} else {
  NA_real_
}
```

```{r sidebar_multifamily_section, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
# Conditionally render a Multi-Family Density block in the sidebar when
# PricePerUnit == "Y". Runs after the setup chunk so SubLandUnitDensity1 is
# already computed.
if (isTRUE(params$PricePerUnit == "Y")) {
  lut_label <- if (!is.null(params$LandUnitType) &&
                   length(params$LandUnitType) > 0 &&
                   any(params$LandUnitType != "")) {
    paste(params$LandUnitType, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "All"
  }

  density_label <- if (is.na(SubLandUnitDensity1)) {
    "n/a"
  } else {
    paste0(SubLandUnitDensity1, " units/acre")
  }

  cat("**Multi-Family Density**\n\n")
  cat("**Land Unit Type:** ", lut_label, "<br>\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Subject Units:** ", format(params$SubLandUnits, big.mark = ","), "<br>\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Subject Density:** ", density_label,
      " *(", params$SubLandUnits, " \u00f7 ", params$SubLotAc, " ac)*<br>\n", sep = "")
  cat("**Unit Count Range:** ", params$LoLandSizeUnit, "\u2013", params$HiLandSizeUnit, " units\n\n", sep = "")
  cat("---\n\n")
}
```

```{r helper_functions, include=FALSE}
# Helper to create circle geometry for distance rings
create_circle_sf <- function(lon, lat, radius_km, n_points = 64) {
  angles <- seq(0, 2 * pi, length.out = n_points)
  lat_rad <- lat * pi / 180
  lon_offset <- (radius_km / 111) / cos(lat_rad)
  lat_offset <- radius_km / 111

  coords <- cbind(
    lon + lon_offset * cos(angles),
    lat + lat_offset * sin(angles)
  )
  coords <- rbind(coords, coords[1,])

  st_sf(
    geometry = st_sfc(st_polygon(list(coords)), crs = 4326),
    radius_km = radius_km
  )
}

add_distance_rings <- function(map, lon, lat, inner_km, outer_km, show = TRUE) {
  if (!show) return(map)
  # Label offset scales with radius: 15% of radius + small minimum
  # This adapts for both small (3 km) and large (70 km) radii
  outer_label_offset <- (outer_km / 111) * 0.1 + 0.005

  # Create outer ring
  outer_ring <- create_circle_sf(lon, lat, outer_km)
  outer_label <- st_sf(
    label = paste0(outer_km, " km"),
    geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(lon, lat + outer_km / 111 + outer_label_offset)), crs = 4326)
  )

  map <- map |>
    add_line_layer(
      id = "outer-ring",
      source = outer_ring,
      line_color = "blue",
      line_width = 1.5
    ) |>
    add_symbol_layer(
      id = "outer-ring-label",
      source = outer_label,
      text_field = get_column("label"),
      text_size = 14,
      text_color = "blue",
      text_font = c("Open Sans Bold", "Arial Unicode MS Bold")
    )

  if (inner_km > 0) {
    inner_ring <- create_circle_sf(lon, lat, inner_km)
    inner_label_offset <- (inner_km / 111) * 0.1 + 0.005
    inner_label <- st_sf(
      label = paste0(inner_km, " km"),
      geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(lon, lat + inner_km / 111 + inner_label_offset)), crs = 4326)
    )

    map <- map |>
      add_line_layer(
        id = "inner-ring",
        source = inner_ring,
        line_color = "black",
        line_width = 2
      ) |>
      add_symbol_layer(
        id = "inner-ring-label",
        source = inner_label,
        text_field = get_column("label"),
        text_size = 14,
        text_color = "black",
        text_font = c("Open Sans Bold", "Arial Unicode MS Bold")
      )
  }

  map
}


apply_uc_filter <- function(df, uc_filter, uc_filter_list) {
  if (!uc_filter %in% c("I", "E")) return(df)

  lookup_list <- get(uc_filter_list, inherits = TRUE)
  col_name <- if (grepl("Wpg", uc_filter_list)) "Municipality" else "City"
  lookup_values <- lookup_list[[col_name]]

  if (uc_filter == "I") {
    filter(df, .data[[col_name]] %in% lookup_values)
  } else {
    filter(df, !.data[[col_name]] %in% lookup_values)
  }
}

# Distance filter helper — consolidates the SubRef branching
apply_dist_filter <- function(df, params, lo_km, hi_km) {
  col <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") "RefDist" else "SubDist"
  filter(df, between(.data[[col]], lo_km, hi_km))
}

# Tooltip builder — standardizes the tooltip text for land maps.
make_tooltip <- function(df, unit_label, ac_or_sf = "ac") {
  paste0(
    df$Address, ", ", df$City,
    "<br>Date: ", format(df$DateSold, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    "<br>Price: ", scales::dollar(df$PriceSold, accuracy = 1),
    "<br>", if(ac_or_sf == "sf") paste0("Land SF: ", scales::comma(df$LandSF, accuracy = 1)) else paste0("Acres: ", round(df$Acres, 2)),
    "<br>$/", unit_label, ": ", if(ac_or_sf == "sf") scales::dollar(df$PriceLandSF, accuracy = 0.01) else scales::dollar(df$PriceAcre, accuracy = 1),
    "<br>Zoning: ", df$Zoning
  )
}

# Build a base map with optional boundary layers, distance rings, and satellite toggle.
build_base_map <- function(bounds, muni_bnd = NULL, wpg_nb_bnd = NULL,
                           muni_color_map = NULL, id_prefix = "map",
                           circle_lon = NULL, circle_lat = NULL,
                           lo_km = 0, hi_km = 0, show_rings = FALSE) {
  map <- maplibre(bounds = bounds) |>
    add_navigation_control(position = "top-left") |>
    add_satellite_layer()

  # Distance rings
  if (show_rings && !is.null(circle_lon)) {
    map <- add_distance_rings(map, circle_lon, circle_lat, lo_km, hi_km, show = TRUE)
  }

  # Municipal boundaries
  if (!is.null(muni_bnd)) {
    map <- map |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = paste0(id_prefix, "_muni_fill"),
        source = muni_bnd,
        fill_color = get_column("fill_color"),
        fill_opacity = 0.05,
        tooltip = "tooltip"
      ) |>
      add_line_layer(
        id = paste0(id_prefix, "_muni_line"),
        source = muni_bnd,
        line_color = "darkblue",
        line_width = 2,
        line_dasharray = c(5, 5)
      )
  }

  # Winnipeg neighbourhood boundaries
  if (!is.null(wpg_nb_bnd)) {
    map <- map |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = paste0(id_prefix, "_wpg_nb_fill"),
        source = wpg_nb_bnd,
        fill_color = get_column("nb_fill_color"),
        fill_opacity = 0.10,
        tooltip = "tooltip"
      ) |>
      add_line_layer(
        id = paste0(id_prefix, "_wpg_nb_line"),
        source = wpg_nb_bnd,
        line_color = get_column("nb_fill_color"),
        line_width = 1.5,
        line_opacity = 0.7
      )
  }

  # Satellite toggle control
  map |>
    add_layers_control(
      position = "top-right",
      layers = list("Satellite" = "satellite-layer")
    )
}

# Prepare municipal boundary attributes once (fill_color + tooltip)
prep_muni_bnd <- function(bnd, color_map) {
  if (is.null(bnd)) return(NULL)
  bnd$fill_color <- color_map[tools::toTitleCase(tolower(bnd$MUNI_LIST_NAME_WITH_TYPE))]
  bnd$tooltip <- bnd$MUNI_LIST_NAME_WITH_TYPE
  bnd
}

# Prepare Winnipeg neighbourhood boundary attributes once (nb_fill_color + tooltip)
prep_wpg_nb_bnd <- function(bnd) {
  if (is.null(bnd)) return(NULL)
  bnd$nb_fill_color <- get_nb_color(bnd$Neighborhood)
  bnd$tooltip <- bnd$Neighborhood
  bnd
}

# Base directory for shared reference files
base_files_dir <- "D:/Dropbox/Appraisal/RProjects/BaseFiles"

# Helper: resolve file from base dir first, then local, or NULL
resolve_file <- function(filename, base_dir = base_files_dir) {
  base_path <- file.path(base_dir, filename)
  if (file.exists(base_path)) return(base_path)
  if (file.exists(filename)) return(filename)
  NULL
}

# OPTIONAL MUNICIPAL BOUNDARIES (base dir -> local -> skip)
muni_all <- NULL
muni_path <- resolve_file("MBMunicipalities.geojson")
if (!is.null(muni_path)) {
  muni_all <- tryCatch({
    st_read(muni_path, quiet = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error reading MBMunicipalities.geojson: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })
}

# Function to filter municipal boundaries for a dataset
get_filtered_muni_boundaries <- function(df_to_match, boundaries = muni_all) {
  # df_to_match is the variable name inside the function
  if(is.null(boundaries)) return(NULL)

  # Normalize the names in your data: Remove dots, uppercase, trim spaces
  cleaned_names <- unique(df_to_match$Municipality) %>%
    gsub("\\.", "", .) %>% 
    toupper() %>%
    trimws()

  # Filter the GeoJSON boundaries using the same normalization
  filtered_bnd <- boundaries %>%
    filter(toupper(gsub("\\.", "", MUNI_LIST_NAME_WITH_TYPE)) %in% cleaned_names)

  if(nrow(filtered_bnd) == 0) return(NULL)

  return(filtered_bnd)
}

wpg_neighbourhoods <- NULL
wpg_neighbourhoods_clustered <- NULL

wpg_nb_path <- resolve_file("WpgNeighbourhoodClusters.geojson")
if (!is.null(wpg_nb_path)) {
  wpg_neighbourhoods <- tryCatch({
    st_read(wpg_nb_path, quiet = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("Error reading WpgNeighbourhoodClusters.geojson: ", e$message)
    NULL
  })

  # File is already dissolved into ~20 cluster polygons — just rename `cluster` -> Neighborhood.
  if (!is.null(wpg_neighbourhoods) && "cluster" %in% names(wpg_neighbourhoods)) {
    wpg_neighbourhoods_clustered <- wpg_neighbourhoods %>%
      rename(Neighborhood = cluster)
  }
}

# Function to get Winnipeg neighbourhood boundaries for a dataset
get_filtered_wpg_nb_boundaries <- function(data_for_filter, boundaries = wpg_neighbourhoods_clustered) {
  if (is.null(boundaries)) return(NULL)

  # Only return boundaries if data includes Winnipeg (City)
  if (!"Winnipeg (City)" %in% data_for_filter$Municipality) return(NULL)

  # Return all neighbourhood boundaries (not filtered by matching data)
  boundaries
}

# Helper function to safely get neighborhood color
# Handles "St" vs "St." mismatch between data sources
get_nb_color <- function(neighborhood) {
  # Build a normalized lookup: strip periods from palette keys
  norm_lookup <- wrha_cluster_colors
  names(norm_lookup) <- gsub("\\.", "", names(norm_lookup))
  # Combine both so exact matches (with period) and normalized (without) both work
  combined_lookup <- c(wrha_cluster_colors, norm_lookup)
  # Remove duplicates (keep first = original with-period version)
  combined_lookup <- combined_lookup[!duplicated(names(combined_lookup))]

  sapply(neighborhood, function(nb) {
    if (is.na(nb) || nb == "Unknown") {
      "#808080"
    } else if (nb %in% names(combined_lookup)) {
      combined_lookup[nb]
    } else {
      "#808080"
    }
  }, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
}

#' Roll small neighbourhoods into an "Other" bucket for boxplots
#'
#' Takes the raw data frame used by a neighbourhood boxplot and returns
#' (1) the raw rows re-tagged so that any neighbourhood outside the top
#' `max_bars` by sale count is labelled `"Other (k nbhds)"`, and (2) a
#' stats frame (med, q3, n) in the same shape the existing boxplots
#' already consume. The returned `Neighborhood` factor is ordered by
#' ascending median so `coord_flip()` keeps the highest at the top.
#'
#' @param df          Raw data frame with `Neighborhood` and the price column.
#' @param price_col   Name of the numeric price column (character).
#' @param max_bars    Max individual neighbourhood boxes to keep (default 10).
#' @return list(df, stats, colors) where
#'   - df      : raw rows with `Neighborhood` re-tagged and factored
#'   - stats   : per-group med/q3/n, `Neighborhood` factored same as df
#'   - colors  : named character vector mapping label -> hex (grey for "Other")
rollup_neighbourhoods_for_boxplot <- function(df, price_col, max_bars = 10) {
  df <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Neighborhood), Neighborhood != "",
           !is.na(.data[[price_col]]))

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(list(df = df, stats = NULL, colors = character()))
  }

  nb_counts <- df %>% count(Neighborhood, sort = TRUE)
  n_total   <- nrow(nb_counts)

  if (n_total <= max_bars) {
    keep_names  <- nb_counts$Neighborhood
    other_label <- NA_character_
  } else {
    keep_names  <- nb_counts$Neighborhood[seq_len(max_bars)]
    n_other     <- n_total - max_bars
    other_label <- paste0("Other (", n_other, " nbhds)")
  }

  df <- df %>%
    mutate(nb_group = ifelse(
      Neighborhood %in% keep_names,
      as.character(Neighborhood),
      other_label
    ))

  stats <- df %>%
    group_by(nb_group) %>%
    summarise(
      med = median(.data[[price_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      q3  = quantile(.data[[price_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      n   = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(med)

  # Build ordered labels "Neighbourhood (n)" and factor both frames
  labels <- paste0(stats$nb_group, " (", stats$n, ")")
  stats$Neighborhood <- factor(labels, levels = labels)

  df$Neighborhood <- factor(
    df$nb_group,
    levels = stats$nb_group,
    labels = labels
  )

  # Colors: real neighbourhoods via palette, "Other" as neutral grey
  base_colors <- get_nb_color(stats$nb_group)
  if (!is.na(other_label)) {
    base_colors[stats$nb_group == other_label] <- "#808080"
  }
  colors <- setNames(base_colors, labels)

  list(df = df, stats = stats, colors = colors)
}

# Helper to get color palette values
get_mapgl_colors <- function(values, palette_name = "Set1", n_bins = NULL) {
  if(is.null(n_bins)) {
    n_unique <- length(unique(values))
    colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(max(3, n_unique), 9), palette_name)
    if(n_unique > length(colors)) {
      colors <- colorRampPalette(colors)(n_unique)
    }
  } else {
    colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(min(max(3, n_bins), 9), palette_name)
  }
  colors
}

# ==============================================================================
# CATEGORICAL LEGEND HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==============================================================================

# Build a robust quantile classification for discrete range-bucket legends.
create_quantile_classification <- function(data, column, n = 5) {
  palette_fn <- \(k) rev(colorRampPalette(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(9, "RdYlBu"))(k))

  cls <- suppressWarnings(
    tryCatch(
      step_quantile(data = data, column = column, n = n, palette = palette_fn),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
  )

  if (is.null(cls) || is.null(cls$labels) || length(cls$labels) == 0 || all(is.na(cls$breaks))) {
    unique_vals <- length(unique(na.omit(data[[column]])))
    fallback_n <- if (unique_vals >= 2) min(n, unique_vals) else 2
    cls <- suppressWarnings(
      step_equal_interval(data = data, column = column, n = fallback_n, palette = palette_fn)
    )
  }

  cls
}

# Assign each row to a bucket label based on classification breaks.
# Returns a list with: bucket_col (column values), color_map (named vector), labels (ordered)
assign_buckets <- function(data, column, classification, label_formatter = NULL) {
  values <- data[[column]]
  raw_breaks <- classification$breaks
  colors <- classification$colors

  # step_quantile/step_equal_interval return breaks including min and max boundaries.
  # Extract only internal thresholds (remove first and last) to match label generation.
  if (length(raw_breaks) > 2) {
    breaks <- raw_breaks[-c(1, length(raw_breaks))]
  } else {
    breaks <- raw_breaks
  }

  # Create bucket labels from breaks
  n_buckets <- length(breaks) + 1
  labels <- character(n_buckets)

  if (!is.null(label_formatter)) {
    # label_formatter may return a list with $labels and $breaks (rounded thresholds)
    # or a plain character vector (legacy). When rounded breaks are provided, use them
    # for classification so that map colors match the legend text exactly.
    fmt_result <- label_formatter(breaks)
    if (is.list(fmt_result) && !is.null(fmt_result$labels)) {
      labels <- fmt_result$labels
      if (!is.null(fmt_result$breaks)) {
        breaks <- fmt_result$breaks
        n_buckets <- length(breaks) + 1
      }
    } else {
      labels <- fmt_result
    }
  } else {
    # Default currency formatting
    labels[1] <- paste0("< ", scales::dollar(breaks[1], accuracy = 1))
    if (length(breaks) > 1) {
      for (i in 2:length(breaks)) {
        labels[i] <- paste0(scales::dollar(breaks[i-1], accuracy = 1), " - ", scales::dollar(breaks[i], accuracy = 1))
      }
    }
    labels[n_buckets] <- paste0(scales::dollar(breaks[length(breaks)], accuracy = 1), "+")
  }

  # Ensure colors match label count
  if (length(colors) != length(labels)) {
    colors <- colorRampPalette(colors)(length(labels))
  }

  # Assign each value to a bucket
  bucket_col <- character(length(values))
  for (i in seq_along(values)) {
    val <- values[i]
    if (is.na(val)) {
      bucket_col[i] <- NA_character_
    } else if (val < breaks[1]) {
      bucket_col[i] <- labels[1]
    } else if (val >= breaks[length(breaks)]) {
      bucket_col[i] <- labels[n_buckets]
    } else {
      for (j in 2:length(breaks)) {
        if (val >= breaks[j-1] && val < breaks[j]) {
          bucket_col[i] <- labels[j]
          break
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Create color map (labels -> colors)
  color_map <- setNames(colors, labels)

  list(
    bucket_col = bucket_col,
    color_map = color_map,
    labels = labels
  )
}

nice_step <- function(values, n_buckets = 5, min_step = NULL) {
  vals <- as.numeric(values)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(ifelse(is.null(min_step), 1, min_step))

  span <- diff(range(vals))
  target <- if (span > 0) span / n_buckets else max(abs(vals), na.rm = TRUE) / n_buckets
  if (!is.finite(target) || target <= 0) target <- ifelse(is.null(min_step), 1, min_step)

  pow10 <- 10 ^ floor(log10(target))
  ratio <- target / pow10
  mult <- if (ratio <= 1) 1 else if (ratio <= 2) 2 else if (ratio <= 5) 5 else 10
  step <- mult * pow10

  if (!is.null(min_step)) step <- max(step, min_step)
  step
}

currency_min_step <- function(values, profile = c("unit_price", "price_per_lot")) {
  profile <- match.arg(profile)
  vals <- as.numeric(values)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return(1)
  max_abs <- max(abs(vals), na.rm = TRUE)

  if (profile == "price_per_lot") {
    if (max_abs >= 5000000) return(50000)
    if (max_abs >= 1000000) return(10000)
    if (max_abs >= 500000)  return(5000)
    if (max_abs >= 100000)  return(1000)
    if (max_abs >= 50000)   return(500)
    if (max_abs >= 10000)   return(100)
    return(10)
  }

  if (max_abs >= 10000) return(100)
  if (max_abs >= 5000)  return(50)
  if (max_abs >= 1000)  return(10)
  if (max_abs >= 500)   return(5)
  1
}

build_bucket_labels <- function(thresholds, currency = TRUE, step = 1) {
  th <- as.numeric(thresholds)
  th <- th[is.finite(th)]
  if (length(th) == 0) return(character(0))

  # Keep thresholds strictly increasing after rounding so ranges remain readable.
  if (length(th) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(th)) {
      if (th[i] <= th[i - 1]) th[i] <- th[i - 1] + step
    }
  }

  label_fmt <- function(x) {
    if (currency) {
      scales::dollar(x, accuracy = max(1, step), big.mark = ",")
    } else {
      scales::number(x, accuracy = step, big.mark = ",")
    }
  }

  labels <- character(length(th) + 1)
  labels[1] <- paste0("< ", label_fmt(th[1]))
  if (length(th) > 1) {
    for (i in 2:length(th)) {
      labels[i] <- paste0(label_fmt(th[i - 1]), " - ", label_fmt(th[i]))
    }
  }
  labels[length(labels)] <- paste0(label_fmt(th[length(th)]), "+")
  labels
}

format_price_bucket_labels <- function(scale_obj, unit_label, kind = c("unit_price", "price_per_lot")) {
  kind <- match.arg(kind)
  cuts <- scale_obj$breaks[-c(1, length(scale_obj$breaks))]
  cuts <- as.numeric(cuts[is.finite(cuts)])

  if (length(cuts) == 0) return(get_legend_labels(scale_obj, format = "currency", digits = 0))

  if (kind == "unit_price" && toupper(unit_label) == "sf") {
    # Request: price/sf legend cutoffs should land on even dollars.
    step <- 2
  } else {
    # For FF/Acre and Price-per-Lot, choose a rounded step based on scale.
    min_step <- currency_min_step(
      cuts,
      profile = if (kind == "price_per_lot") "price_per_lot" else "unit_price"
    )
    step <- nice_step(cuts, n_buckets = 5, min_step = min_step)
  }

  rounded_cuts <- round(cuts / step) * step
  labels <- build_bucket_labels(rounded_cuts, currency = TRUE, step = step)
  list(labels = labels, breaks = rounded_cuts)
}

# ==============================================================================
# FEATURE IMPORTANCE HELPER
# ==============================================================================
# Uses explore::explain_forest() to generate ML feature importance bar charts.
# Whitelist approach: only known predictor columns are considered as features.
# The target column and any all-NA / zero-variance columns are automatically excluded.

fi_prepare_and_plot <- function(df, target_col, ntree = 50) {
  # Whitelist of potential predictor columns across all dashboard types
  feature_candidates <- c(
    "GBA", "YrBlt", "FAR", "Acres", "LandSF", "Stories", "Units",
    "SubDist", "RefDist", "DOM", "CapRate", "CeilingHt",
    "DoorsGrade", "DoorsDock", "ExpRatio",
    "PropMajor", "Condition", "Quality", "Zoning", "ZoningType",
    "Neighborhood", "Visibility", "Access", "View", "MASC"
  )

  # Intersect with columns that actually exist, then remove the target
  available_features <- intersect(feature_candidates, names(df))
  available_features <- setdiff(available_features, target_col)

  # Build analysis dataframe: target + features only
  analysis_df <- df[, c(target_col, available_features), drop = FALSE]

  # Remove rows where target is NA
  analysis_df <- analysis_df[!is.na(analysis_df[[target_col]]), , drop = FALSE]

  # Drop columns that are all-NA, zero-variance, or >50% NA (too sparse)
  n_rows <- nrow(analysis_df)
  keep_cols <- vapply(analysis_df, function(x) {
    na_frac <- sum(is.na(x)) / n_rows
    if (na_frac > 0.5) return(FALSE)
    if (all(is.na(x))) return(FALSE)
    if (is.numeric(x)) {
      valid <- x[!is.na(x)]
      return(length(valid) >= 2 && sd(valid) > 0)
    }
    if (is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) return(length(unique(na.omit(x))) > 1)
    TRUE
  }, logical(1))
  keep_cols[target_col] <- TRUE
  analysis_df <- analysis_df[, keep_cols, drop = FALSE]

  # Convert character columns to factors (randomForest requires factors)
  char_cols <- vapply(analysis_df, is.character, logical(1))
  analysis_df[char_cols] <- lapply(analysis_df[char_cols], as.factor)

  # Impute remaining NAs: median for numeric, "Missing" level for factors
  # (randomForest cannot handle any NA values; na.omit is too aggressive)
  for (col in names(analysis_df)) {
    if (col == target_col) next
    if (any(is.na(analysis_df[[col]]))) {
      if (is.numeric(analysis_df[[col]])) {
        analysis_df[[col]][is.na(analysis_df[[col]])] <- median(analysis_df[[col]], na.rm = TRUE)
      } else if (is.factor(analysis_df[[col]])) {
        levels(analysis_df[[col]]) <- c(levels(analysis_df[[col]]), "Missing")
        analysis_df[[col]][is.na(analysis_df[[col]])] <- "Missing"
      }
    }
  }

  # Need at least 2 feature columns and 10 rows for a meaningful forest
  feature_count <- ncol(analysis_df) - 1
  if (feature_count < 2 || nrow(analysis_df) < 10) {
    return(ggplot() +
      annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
               label = "Insufficient data for feature importance analysis",
               size = 6) +
      theme_void())
  }

  # Run the random forest and return the ggplot object
  tryCatch(
    explore::explain_forest(analysis_df,
                            target = !!rlang::sym(target_col),
                            ntree = ntree,
                            out = "plot"),
    error = function(e) {
      ggplot() +
        annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5,
                 label = paste0("Feature importance error:\n", e$message),
                 size = 5) +
        theme_void()
    }
  )
}
```

```{r load_data_with_caching, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# DATA LOADING WITH SMART CACHING
# ==============================================================================
# Only re-imports from CSV if SearchPropResults.csv has been modified since
# the last preprocessing. Otherwise loads from cache for faster rendering.

csv_file <- "./SearchPropResults.csv"
cache_file <- "./ADF_preprocessed.RDS"

needs_refresh <- TRUE

if (file.exists(cache_file) && file.exists(csv_file)) {
  cache <- readRDS(cache_file)
  csv_mtime <- file.mtime(csv_file)

  # Check if cache has timestamp and if CSV hasn't changed
  if (!is.null(cache$csv_mtime) && cache$csv_mtime >= csv_mtime) {
    ADF <- cache$data
    needs_refresh <- FALSE
    cat("Loaded", nrow(ADF), "records from cache (CSV unchanged)\n")
  }
}

if (needs_refresh) {
  cat("CSV file changed or no cache - importing fresh data...\n")

  # Load raw data
  ADF <- read_csv(csv_file,
    col_types = cols(
      `Property Id` = col_double(),

    ), show_col_types = FALSE
  )

  # Rename columns
  rename_map <- c(

    PropMajor = "Property Type",
    PropTypeMajor = "Property Major Type",
    PropSubType = "Property Sub Type",
    LandUnitType = "Land Unit Type",

    DOM = "Days On Market",

    PriceListOrig = "Original List Price",
    PriceListOrigDiff = "Original List Price Difference",
    CeilingHt = "Ceiling Height",
    YrBlt = "Year Built Numeric",
    PriceBldgSF = "Improvement Value Per SF",
    LandValue = "Land Value",
    MASC = "MASC Rating",
    PercentCult = "Percent Tillable"
  )

  # Check which columns exist and rename
  existing_cols <- rename_map[rename_map %in% names(ADF)]
  if(length(existing_cols) > 0) {
    ADF <- rename(ADF, !!!existing_cols)
  }

  # Support either source-header casing for DOM and normalize to DOM.
  if (!"DOM" %in% names(ADF)) {
    dom_candidates <- c("Days on Market", "Days On Market")
    dom_col <- dom_candidates[dom_candidates %in% names(ADF)][1]
    if (!is.na(dom_col) && nzchar(dom_col)) {
      ADF <- rename(ADF, DOM = all_of(dom_col))
    }
  }

  # Select relevant columns
  desired_cols <- c("N1ID", "City", "Municipality", "Address", "DateSold",
                    "PriceSold", "Acres", "PriceAcre", "LandSF", "PriceLandSF",
                    "LandUnits", "LandUnitType", "PriceLandUnit", "Zoning",
                    "Neighborhood", "PropMajor", "PropSubType", "TaxID",
                    "Lat", "Lon", "TrxType", "DOM", "PriceListOrig",
                    "PriceListOrigDiff", "Dimensions", "Visibility", "Access")

  ADF <- ADF[, intersect(desired_cols, names(ADF)), drop = FALSE]

  # Filter out listings and pending contracts
  ADF <- filter(ADF, !(TrxType %in% c("Listing", "Pending Contract")))

  # Calculate derived columns
  ADF <- ADF %>% mutate(SaleYear = year(DateSold))

  # Round numeric columns for display
  ADF$PriceAcre <- round(ADF$PriceAcre, 2)
  ADF$PriceLandSF <- round(ADF$PriceLandSF, 4)
  ADF$PriceLandUnit <- round(ADF$PriceLandUnit, 0)

  # Calculate Land Units/Acre density if both columns exist
  if("LandUnits" %in% names(ADF) && "Acres" %in% names(ADF)) {
    ADF <- ADF %>% mutate(DUAcre = ifelse(!is.na(LandUnits) & !is.na(Acres) & Acres > 0,
                                           LandUnits / Acres, NA))
  }

  # Convert DOM to numeric
  ADF$DOM <- as.numeric(as.character(ADF$DOM))

  # Save to cache with CSV timestamp
  saveRDS(list(data = ADF, csv_mtime = file.mtime(csv_file)), cache_file)
  cat("Processed and cached", nrow(ADF), "records\n")
}

target_price_col <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") "PriceLandSF" else "PriceAcre"
target_size_col  <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") "LandSF" else "Acres"

circle_radius <- 6

# Dynamic size filter bounds
lo_size <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") params$LoLandSizeSF else params$LoLandSizeAc
hi_size <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") params$HiLandSizeSF else params$HiLandSizeAc

# Calculate the total range of the X-axis
size_range <- hi_size - lo_size

# Set accuracy based on the SPAN of the data, not just the max value
size_accuracy <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") {
  1  # Square feet always rounds to the nearest whole number
} else {
  if(size_range <= 3) 0.01 else  # Tiny range: show 2 decimals (e.g., 2.25)
  if(size_range <= 15) 0.1 else  # Small range: show 1 decimal (e.g., 2.5)
  1                              # Large range: whole numbers only
}

price_accuracy  <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") 0.01 else 1
unit_precision   <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") 4 else 2
sub_lot_size     <- if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") params$SubLotSF else params$SubLotAc

cat("Switchboard configured for:", toupper(params$AcOrSF), "\n")
```

```{r calculate_parameter_dependent_fields, include=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# Fill missing Neighborhood via spatial join against WpgNeighbourhoods.
# Any ADF row with a blank/NA Neighborhood but a valid Lat/Lon inside a
# Winnipeg cluster polygon gets that cluster's name. Rows outside all
# polygons (e.g. industrial areas) or outside Winnipeg are handled by
# the City-fallback step below.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if (!"Neighborhood" %in% names(ADF)) {
  ADF$Neighborhood <- NA_character_
}

if (!is.null(wpg_neighbourhoods_clustered) && all(c("Lat", "Lon") %in% names(ADF))) {
  needs_nb <- (is.na(ADF$Neighborhood) | ADF$Neighborhood == "") &
              !is.na(ADF$Lat) & !is.na(ADF$Lon)

  if (any(needs_nb)) {
    idx <- which(needs_nb)
    pts <- sf::st_as_sf(
      data.frame(Lon = ADF$Lon[idx], Lat = ADF$Lat[idx]),
      coords = c("Lon", "Lat"),
      crs = 4326
    )

    nb_bnd <- sf::st_transform(
      wpg_neighbourhoods_clustered[, "Neighborhood"],
      sf::st_crs(pts)
    )

    joined <- suppressMessages(
      sf::st_join(pts, nb_bnd, join = sf::st_intersects, left = TRUE)
    )

    matched <- as.character(joined$Neighborhood)
    has_match <- !is.na(matched)
    if (any(has_match)) {
      ADF$Neighborhood[idx[has_match]] <- matched[has_match]
      message(sprintf(
        "Filled %d missing Neighborhood value(s) via spatial join on WpgNeighbourhoodClusters.geojson",
        sum(has_match)
      ))
    }
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------
# City fallback for non-Winnipeg records.
# Any row that still has a blank/NA Neighborhood and is NOT inside
# Winnipeg (City) gets its City value copied into Neighborhood so that
# downstream charts/filters group these sales by their municipality.
# ------------------------------------------------------------------
if ("City" %in% names(ADF)) {
  still_missing <- is.na(ADF$Neighborhood) | ADF$Neighborhood == ""
  not_winnipeg  <- if ("Municipality" %in% names(ADF)) {
    is.na(ADF$Municipality) | ADF$Municipality != "Winnipeg (City)"
  } else {
    rep(TRUE, nrow(ADF))
  }
  city_has_value <- !is.na(ADF$City) & ADF$City != ""
  use_city <- still_missing & not_winnipeg & city_has_value

  if (any(use_city)) {
    ADF$Neighborhood[use_city] <- as.character(ADF$City[use_city])
    message(sprintf(
      "Filled %d missing Neighborhood value(s) from City for non-Winnipeg records",
      sum(use_city)
    ))
  }
}

# Calculate distance and popup fields (depend on parameters)
ADF$SubDist <- round(distHaversine(cbind(ADF$Lon, ADF$Lat),
                                    c(params$SubLon, params$SubLat)) / 1000, 1)
ADF$RefDist <- round(distHaversine(cbind(ADF$Lon, ADF$Lat),
                                    c(params$RefLon, params$RefLat)) / 1000, 1)
ADF$ChgInDays <- ymd(params$EffDate) - ymd(ADF$DateSold)

# ==============================================================================
# DYNAMIC POPUPS (UNIT-AWARE)
# ==============================================================================
ADF$popup <- paste0(
  "<b>N1 ID:</b> ", ADF$N1ID, "<br>",
  "<b>Address:</b> ", ADF$Address, "<br>",
  "<b>City:</b> ", ADF$City, "<br>",
  "<b>Sale Date:</b> ", ADF$DateSold, "<br>",
  "<b>Price:</b> ", scales::dollar(ADF$PriceSold, accuracy = 1, big.mark = ","), "<br>",

  # Dynamic Size Line
  "<b>", unit_label_full, ":</b> ",
  scales::number(as.numeric(ADF[[target_size_col]]),
                 accuracy = size_accuracy,
                 big.mark = ","), "<br>",

  # Dynamic Price per Unit Line
  "<b>Price/", unit_label, ":</b> ",
  scales::dollar(ADF[[target_price_col]],
                 accuracy = price_accuracy,
                 big.mark = ","), "<br>",

  "<b>Zoning:</b> ", ADF$Zoning, "<br>",
  "<b>Sub Distance:</b> ", ADF$SubDist, " km<br>",
  "<b>Ref Distance:</b> ", ADF$RefDist, " km"
)

# Set circle coordinates for maps
circle_lat <- ifelse(params$SubRef == "Sub", params$SubLat, params$RefLat)
circle_lon <- ifelse(params$SubRef == "Sub", params$SubLon, params$RefLon)

# Create user-defined lists
UDC <- data.frame(City = params$CityList)
# Parse pipe-delimited outliers: "N1ID|Reason" or just "N1ID"
CMSOutliers <- if(length(params$Outliers) > 0 && any(params$Outliers != "")) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(params$Outliers, function(x) {
    parts <- strsplit(as.character(x), "\\|")[[1]]
    data.frame(
      N1ID = trimws(parts[1]),
      Reason = if(length(parts) > 1) trimws(parts[2]) else "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }))
} else {
  data.frame(N1ID = character(0), Reason = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
ZoningFilterList <- data.frame(N1ID = as.character(params$ZoningFilter))

# Subject property data frame for reference lines
Subject <- data.frame(
  RefDist = round(distHaversine(c(params$SubLon, params$SubLat),
                                 c(params$RefLon, params$RefLat)) / 1000, 1),
  SubDist = 0
)

# Date variables for subtitles
LoDate <- as.Date(params$LoSaleDate)
HiDate <- as.Date(HiSaleDate)

# Find unique property types for color palette
UniquePropTypeADF <- unique(ADF$PropMajor)

cat("Parameter-dependent fields calculated\n")

# Function to add subject and reference markers
add_property_markers <- function(map, params) {
  # Create subject property marker
  subject_marker <- st_sf(
    label = "Subject Property",
    geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(params$SubLon, params$SubLat)), crs = 4326)
  )

  map <- map |>
    mapgl::add_markers(
      data = subject_marker,
      color = "red",
      popup = "label"
    )

  # Add reference marker if needed
  if (params$SubRef != "Sub") {
    ref_marker <- st_sf(
      label = "Reference Point",
      geometry = st_sfc(st_point(c(params$RefLon, params$RefLat)), crs = 4326)
    )
    map <- map |>
      mapgl::add_markers(
        data = ref_marker,
        color = "black",
        popup = "label"
      )
  }

  map
}
cat("Property Marker Function Defined\n")

# Returns a numeric vector c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax) suitable for maplibre(bounds = ...).
compute_map_bounds <- function(sf_data = NULL, params, radius_km = NULL) {
  circle_lat <- ifelse(params$SubRef == "Sub", params$SubLat, params$RefLat)
  circle_lon <- ifelse(params$SubRef == "Sub", params$SubLon, params$RefLon)

  has_sf_data <- !is.null(sf_data) && inherits(sf_data, "sf") && nrow(sf_data) > 0
  if (has_sf_data) {
    data_bbox <- st_bbox(sf_data)
    xmin <- data_bbox["xmin"]
    xmax <- data_bbox["xmax"]
    ymin <- data_bbox["ymin"]
    ymax <- data_bbox["ymax"]
  } else {
    xmin <- xmax <- circle_lon
    ymin <- ymax <- circle_lat
  }

  # Always include the subject marker.
  xmin <- min(xmin, params$SubLon)
  xmax <- max(xmax, params$SubLon)
  ymin <- min(ymin, params$SubLat)
  ymax <- max(ymax, params$SubLat)

  # Include reference marker when applicable.
  if (params$SubRef != "Sub") {
    xmin <- min(xmin, params$RefLon)
    xmax <- max(xmax, params$RefLon)
    ymin <- min(ymin, params$RefLat)
    ymax <- max(ymax, params$RefLat)
  }

  # Fit to the outer distance ring (and top label offset) ONLY when
  # params$ShowRadius == "Y". Otherwise the bbox stays at data extent so the
  # map zooms tight to the points. Default (missing param) = "N".
  show_radius <- !is.null(params$ShowRadius) &&
                 toupper(as.character(params$ShowRadius)) == "Y"
  if (show_radius && !is.null(radius_km) && is.finite(radius_km) && radius_km > 0) {
    lat_rad <- circle_lat * pi / 180
    lat_offset <- radius_km / 111
    lon_offset <- radius_km / (111 * cos(lat_rad))
    label_offset <- (radius_km / 111) * 0.15 + 0.005

    xmin <- min(xmin, circle_lon - lon_offset)
    xmax <- max(xmax, circle_lon + lon_offset)
    ymin <- min(ymin, circle_lat - lat_offset)
    ymax <- max(ymax, circle_lat + lat_offset + label_offset)
  }

  # Avoid zero-width/height bounds for single-point maps.
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(xmin, xmax))) {
    xmin <- xmin - 0.005
    xmax <- xmax + 0.005
  }
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(ymin, ymax))) {
    ymin <- ymin - 0.005
    ymax <- ymax + 0.005
  }

  # Pad the bbox so edge markers aren't clipped in exported PNGs / tight
  # dashboard views. When ShowRadius == "Y" the radius ring already provides
  # slack, so we use a smaller pad; when ShowRadius == "N" the bbox hugs the
  # data tightly and needs a bigger pad (~8% of span each side).
  pad_frac <- if (show_radius) 0.02 else 0.07
  x_span <- xmax - xmin
  y_span <- ymax - ymin
  xmin <- xmin - x_span * pad_frac
  xmax <- xmax + x_span * pad_frac
  ymin <- ymin - y_span * pad_frac
  ymax <- ymax + y_span * pad_frac

  as.numeric(c(xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax))
}
cat("Map Bounds Function Defined\n")
```

```{r apply_cms_filters, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# APPLY FILTERS TO CREATE CMS (Comparable Market Set) - SWITCHBOARD PATTERN
# ==============================================================================

# Determine filter mode flags
prop_major_filter <- length(params$PropMajorInc) > 0 &&
                     !all(params$PropMajorInc == "")

# Apply CMS filters using switchboard variables (lo_size, hi_size, target_size_col)
CMS1 <- ADF %>%
  filter(
    between(DateSold, as.Date(params$LoSaleDate), as.Date(HiSaleDate)),
    !N1ID %in% CMSOutliers$N1ID
  ) %>%
  # Dynamic Land Size Filter using switchboard
  filter(between(as.numeric(.data[[target_size_col]]), lo_size, hi_size)) %>%
  # Zoning Filter Logic
  {if (!is.null(params$ZoningFilter) && length(params$ZoningFilter) > 0 && any(params$ZoningFilter != "")) {
    filter(., Zoning %in% params$ZoningFilter)
  } else .} %>%
  # Apply distance filter
  {if(params$SubRef == "Ref") {
    filter(., between(RefDist, params$LoDistKM, params$HiDistKM))
  } else {
    filter(., SubDist <= params$HiDistKM)
  }} %>%
  # Apply property major type filter
  {if(prop_major_filter) {
    filter(., PropMajor %in% params$PropMajorInc)
  } else .} %>%
  # Apply UC filter
  apply_uc_filter(params$UCFilter, params$UCFilterList) %>%
  # Filter by Neighborhood (only exclude when NeighborhoodExcl has real values)
  filter(
    if ("Neighborhood" %in% names(.) &&
        length(params$NeighborhoodExcl) > 0 &&
        any(params$NeighborhoodExcl != "")) {
      !Neighborhood %in% params$NeighborhoodExcl
    } else {
      TRUE
    }
  )

cat(paste0("CMS Filtered using ", unit_label, ": ", nrow(CMS1), " records\n"))

CMS1$popup <- ADF$popup[ADF$N1ID %in% CMS1$N1ID]

cat("CMS filtered:", nrow(CMS1), "records\n")

# ==============================================================================
# MULTI-FAMILY DATA PREPARATION (CMSLU)
# Built from CMS1: first drop records with no LandUnits, then apply the
# YAML LoLandSizeUnit/HiLandSizeUnit range filter, then optionally filter
# by Land Unit Type (Apartment/Condo/Lot/Other) per LandUnitType YAML param.
# ==============================================================================
if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") {
  # Determine whether the LandUnitType filter is active.
  # Empty list, all-blank list, or NULL = include ALL records (no filter).
  lut_filter_active <- !is.null(params$LandUnitType) &&
                       length(params$LandUnitType) > 0 &&
                       any(params$LandUnitType != "")

  CMSLU <- CMS1 %>%
    # 1. Drop records where LandUnits / PriceLandUnit are missing or non-positive
    filter(
      !is.na(LandUnits),
      !is.na(PriceLandUnit),
      PriceLandUnit > 0
    ) %>%
    # 2. Apply unit-count range filter from YAML params
    filter(between(LandUnits, params$LoLandSizeUnit, params$HiLandSizeUnit)) %>%
    # 3. Optionally filter by Land Unit Type
    {if (lut_filter_active && "LandUnitType" %in% names(.)) {
      filter(., LandUnitType %in% params$LandUnitType)
    } else .}

  cat("Multi-Family CMS (CMSLU) created with", nrow(CMSLU), "records",
      if(lut_filter_active) paste0(" (LandUnitType filter: ", paste(params$LandUnitType, collapse=", "), ")") else " (no LandUnitType filter)",
      ".\n", sep="")
} else {
  CMSLU <- data.frame() # Empty if not enabled
}

cat("CMS with Land Units (Filtered):", nrow(CMSLU), "records\n")
```

```{r market_condition_adjustments, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# MARKET CONDITION ANALYSIS (DYNAMIC UNIT VERSION)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. INITIAL ANALYSIS (Full CMS1) - Using switchboard pattern
if(nrow(CMS1) > 2) {
  # Dynamic Regression formula
  formula_str <- paste(target_price_col, "~ as.numeric(DateSold)")
  MktCond1 <- lm(as.formula(formula_str), data = CMS1)
  MktCondVal1 <- round(coef(MktCond1)[2], 6)

  # Calculate statistics
  MedianPriceUnit1 <- median(CMS1[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE)
  MeanPriceUnit1 <- mean(CMS1[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE)

  # Apply time adjustments to CMS1
  CMS1 <- CMS1 %>%
    mutate(
      MktCondAdj = coef(MktCond1)[2],
      AdjPrice = round((MktCondAdj * as.numeric(ChgInDays)) + .data[[target_price_col]], unit_precision)
    )

  # Calculate annual increase
  AnnualIncreaseDol1 <- coef(MktCond1)[2] * 365
  AnnualIncreasePer1 <- AnnualIncreaseDol1 / MedianPriceUnit1
} else {
  MktCondVal1 <- 0
  MedianPriceUnit1 <- NA_real_
  AnnualIncreasePer1 <- 0
  CMS1$AdjPrice <- CMS1[[target_price_col]]
}

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CMS1 PRICE-PER-ACRE TIME ADJUSTMENT (always fitted, regardless of AcOrSF)
# Used by all multi-family / CMSLU time-adjusted charts so that the rate is
# anchored to the broader CMS1 trend rather than refitted on the smaller
# CMSLU subset.
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
if(nrow(CMS1) > 2 && "PriceAcre" %in% names(CMS1)) {
  MktCondAc1 <- lm(PriceAcre ~ as.numeric(DateSold), data = CMS1)
  MktCondValAc1 <- round(coef(MktCondAc1)[2], 6)   # $/Acre/day
  MedianPriceAc1 <- median(CMS1$PriceAcre, na.rm = TRUE)
  PctChgPerDayAc1 <- if(!is.na(MedianPriceAc1) && MedianPriceAc1 > 0) {
    MktCondValAc1 / MedianPriceAc1
  } else 0
} else {
  MktCondValAc1 <- 0
  MedianPriceAc1 <- NA_real_
  PctChgPerDayAc1 <- 0
}

# 2. LAND UNIT ANALYSIS (if enabled)
# Time adjustments are NOT refitted on CMSLU - they reuse the CMS1-derived
# daily rate (MktCondVal1, which is $/Acre/day or $/SF/day depending on the
# AcOrSF switchboard) and the $/Ac-based percentage-per-day rate
# (PctChgPerDayAc1) for the per-unit percentage adjustment.
if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y" && nrow(CMSLU) > 2) {
  CMSLU <- CMSLU %>%
    mutate(
      # Dynamic per-unit (Acre or SF) adjustment: adds the CMS1 daily rate
      # to whichever nominal price column is selected by AcOrSF.
      AdjPriceLU = round(.data[[target_price_col]] +
                         MktCondVal1 * as.numeric(ChgInDays),
                         unit_precision),
      # Per-Land-Unit adjustment: percentage growth derived from CMS1 $/Ac trend
      AdjPriceUnit = round(PriceLandUnit * (1 + PctChgPerDayAc1 * as.numeric(ChgInDays)), 0)
    )
}

# 3. OUTLIER-RESISTANT ANALYSIS (CMS2: 5th-95th Percentile)
if(nrow(CMS1) > 5) {
  # Calculate quantiles based on selected unit
  CMS_Quantiles1 <- quantile(CMS1[[target_price_col]], probs = c(0.05, 0.95), na.rm = TRUE)

  CMS2 <- CMS1 %>%
    filter(.data[[target_price_col]] >= CMS_Quantiles1[["5%"]] &
           .data[[target_price_col]] <= CMS_Quantiles1[["95%"]])

  if(nrow(CMS2) > 2) {
    formula_str2 <- paste(target_price_col, "~ as.numeric(DateSold)")
    MktCond2 <- lm(as.formula(formula_str2), data = CMS2)
    MktCondVal2 <- round(coef(MktCond2)[2], unit_precision)
    MedianPriceUnit2 <- median(CMS2[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE)

    # Apply secondary adjustments to CMS2
    CMS2 <- CMS2 %>%
      mutate(
        # Ensure CMS2 market-condition columns are based on the CMS2 trend, not inherited CMS1 values.
        MktCondAdj = coef(MktCond2)[2],
        AdjPrice = round((MktCondAdj * as.numeric(ChgInDays)) + .data[[target_price_col]], unit_precision)
      )

    AnnualIncreaseDol2 <- coef(MktCond2)[2] * 365
    AnnualIncreasePer2 <- AnnualIncreaseDol2 / MedianPriceUnit2
  } else {
    MktCondVal2 <- 0
    MedianPriceUnit2 <- NA_real_
    AnnualIncreasePer2 <- 0
    CMS2 <- CMS2 %>%
      mutate(
        MktCondAdj = MktCondVal2,
        AdjPrice = .data[[target_price_col]]
      )
  }
} else {
  CMS2 <- CMS1
  MktCondVal2 <- MktCondVal1
  MedianPriceUnit2 <- MedianPriceUnit1
  AnnualIncreasePer2 <- AnnualIncreasePer1
  CMS2 <- CMS2 %>%
    mutate(
      MktCondAdj = MktCondVal2,
      AdjPrice = round((MktCondAdj * as.numeric(ChgInDays)) + .data[[target_price_col]], unit_precision)
    )
}

# Date formatting for axis labels - max 6 breaks
cms_date_min <- min(CMS1$DateSold, na.rm = TRUE)
cms_date_max <- max(CMS1$DateSold, na.rm = TRUE)
date_breaks_vec <- pretty(c(cms_date_min, cms_date_max), n = 5)
date_breaks_vec <- as.Date(date_breaks_vec, origin = "1970-01-01")
date_label_format <- "%b-%Y"

# Dynamic subtitle templates
Subtitle1 <- paste0("CMS; ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref",
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM),
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM)),
  " km from ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref", params$RefPoint, "subject"),
  "; ",
  if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") paste0(format(lo_size, big.mark=","), "-", format(hi_size, big.mark=","), " sf")
  else paste0(lo_size, "-", hi_size, " acres"),
  "; ", format(LoDate, "%b-%Y"), " to ", format(HiDate, "%b-%Y")
)

Subtitle2 <- paste0("CMS (Time-Adjusted); ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref",
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM),
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM)),
  " km from ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref", params$RefPoint, "subject"),
  "; ",
  if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") paste0(format(lo_size, big.mark=","), "-", format(hi_size, big.mark=","), " SF")
  else paste0(lo_size, "-", hi_size, " acres"),
  "; ", format(LoDate, "%b-%Y"), " to ", format(HiDate, "%b-%Y")
)

Subtitle3 <- paste0("CMS (5th-95th Percentile); ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref",
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM),
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM)),
  " km from ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref", params$RefPoint, "subject"),
  "; ",
  if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") paste0(format(lo_size, big.mark=","), "-", format(hi_size, big.mark=","), " SF")
  else paste0(lo_size, "-", hi_size, " acres"),
  "; ", format(LoDate, "%b-%Y"), " to ", format(HiDate, "%b-%Y")
)

Subtitle4 <- paste0("CMS (5th-95th Percentile, Time-Adjusted); ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref",
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM),
         paste0(params$LoDistKM, "-", params$HiDistKM)),
  " km from ",
  ifelse(params$SubRef == "Ref", params$RefPoint, "subject"),
  "; ",
  if(params$AcOrSF == "sf") paste0(format(lo_size, big.mark=","), "-", format(hi_size, big.mark=","), " SF")
  else paste0(lo_size, "-", hi_size, " acres"),
  "; ", format(LoDate, "%b-%Y"), " to ", format(HiDate, "%b-%Y")
)

cat("Market conditions calculated\n")
cat("  CMS1: Daily", unit_label, "change = $", MktCondVal1, "\n")
cat("  CMS2:", nrow(CMS2), "records (5th-95th percentile)\n")
```

```{r color_palettes, include=FALSE}
# Helper function to create sf object from data frame with lat/lon
make_points_sf <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(Lon) & !is.na(Lat)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326)
}

# Add satellite layer helper for mapgl
add_satellite_layer <- function(map, source_id = "satellite-source", layer_id = "satellite-layer") {
  map |>
    add_raster_source(
      id = source_id,
      tiles = "https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}",
      tileSize = 256,
      maxzoom = 19
    ) |>
    add_raster_layer(
      id = layer_id,
      source = source_id,
      visibility = "none"
    )
}
```

```{r precompute_spatial, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# PRECOMPUTE SHARED SPATIAL OBJECTS
# Boundary subsets and base sf objects are identical across multiple map chunks.
# Computing them once here avoids redundant work during rendering.
# ==============================================================================

# ADF: base sf + boundaries (shared by 2 ADF map chunks)
ADF <- ADF %>% mutate(tooltip = make_tooltip(cur_data(), unit_label, params$AcOrSF))
ADF_sf_base <- make_points_sf(ADF)
muni_bnd_adf <- prep_muni_bnd(get_filtered_muni_boundaries(ADF), muni_color_map)
wpg_nb_bnd_adf <- prep_wpg_nb_bnd(get_filtered_wpg_nb_boundaries(ADF))
map_bbox_adf <- compute_map_bounds(ADF_sf_base, params)

# CMS1: base sf + boundaries (shared by 3 CMS map chunks)
if (nrow(CMS1) > 0) {
  CMS1$fill_color <- prop_color_map[CMS1$PropMajor]
  CMS1$zoning_fill_color <- zoning_color_map[CMS1$Zoning]
  CMS1 <- CMS1 %>% mutate(tooltip = make_tooltip(cur_data(), unit_label, params$AcOrSF))
  CMS1_sf_base <- make_points_sf(CMS1)
  muni_bnd_cms1 <- prep_muni_bnd(get_filtered_muni_boundaries(CMS1), muni_color_map)
  wpg_nb_bnd_cms1 <- prep_wpg_nb_bnd(get_filtered_wpg_nb_boundaries(CMS1))
  map_bbox_cms1 <- compute_map_bounds(CMS1_sf_base, params, radius_km = params$HiDistKM)
}

# CMS2: base sf + boundaries (shared by CMS2 map chunks)
if (nrow(CMS2) > 0) {
  CMS2$fill_color <- prop_color_map[CMS2$PropMajor]
  CMS2$zoning_fill_color <- zoning_color_map[CMS2$Zoning]
  CMS2 <- CMS2 %>% mutate(tooltip = make_tooltip(cur_data(), unit_label, params$AcOrSF))
  CMS2_sf_base <- make_points_sf(CMS2)
  muni_bnd_cms2 <- prep_muni_bnd(get_filtered_muni_boundaries(CMS2), muni_color_map)
  wpg_nb_bnd_cms2 <- prep_wpg_nb_bnd(get_filtered_wpg_nb_boundaries(CMS2))
  map_bbox_cms2 <- compute_map_bounds(CMS2_sf_base, params, radius_km = params$HiDistKM)
}
```

```{r map_adf_heatmap, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("ADF - All Data by Price/", unit_label)

# Use precomputed sf with tooltip (filter for non-NA price)
ADF_sf <- ADF_sf_base %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[target_price_col]]))

# Discrete quantile color scale (5 buckets with rounded values)
adf_price_scale <- create_quantile_classification(
  data = ADF_sf,
  column = target_price_col,
  n = 5
)

# Assign each point to a price bucket for categorical legend interactivity
adf_buckets <- assign_buckets(
  data = ADF_sf,
  column = target_price_col,
  classification = adf_price_scale,
  label_formatter = function(breaks) format_price_bucket_labels(adf_price_scale, unit_label, kind = "unit_price")
)
ADF_sf$price_bucket <- adf_buckets$bucket_col

# Create match expression for categorical coloring
adf_price_match_expr <- match_expr(
  column = "price_bucket",
  values = adf_buckets$labels,
  stops = unname(adf_buckets$color_map),
  default = "#808080"
)

# Build base map with boundaries
Map1ADFH <- build_base_map(
  bounds = map_bbox_adf,
  muni_bnd = muni_bnd_adf, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_adf,
  muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "adf_heatmap",
  circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
  lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = FALSE
)

# Add data layer and categorical legend (click legend items to show/hide)
Map1ADFH <- Map1ADFH |>
  add_circle_layer(
    id = "adf-heatmap",
    source = ADF_sf,
    circle_color = adf_price_match_expr,
    circle_radius = circle_radius,
    circle_stroke_color = "black",
    circle_stroke_width = 1,
    circle_opacity = 0.8,
    tooltip = "tooltip",
    popup = "popup"
  ) |>
  add_property_markers(params) |>

    colors = unname(adf_buckets$color_map),
    type = "categorical",

  )
```

```{r adf_map_neighbourhood, warning=FALSE}
  # Create match expression for categorical coloring by neighbourhood
  adf_nb_match_expr <- match_expr(
    column = "Neighborhood",
    values = names(adf_nb_color_map),

    default = "#808080"
  )

  # Build base map with neighbourhood boundaries (no muni boundaries)
  MapADFN <- build_base_map(
    bounds = map_bbox_adf,
    muni_bnd = NULL, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_adf,

    circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,

  ) |>
    add_property_markers(params)

  MapADFN <- MapADFN |>
    add_circle_layer(
      id = "adf-neighborhood-points",
      source = ADF_sf_nb,
      circle_color = adf_nb_match_expr,

      type = "categorical",
      layer_id = "adf-neighborhood-points",
      interactive = TRUE,
      position = "bottom-right"
    )

  MapADFN
} else {
  empty_map()
}
```

### Price/`r unit_label` Over Time
```{r adf_trend, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("ADF - Overall Trend - All Data by Price/", unit_label)

# ADF date axis: always use year-based breaks and labels
adf_range_years <- as.numeric(difftime(max(ADF$DateSold, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       min(ADF$DateSold, na.rm = TRUE),
                                       units = "days")) / 365
adf_break_interval <- case_when(
  adf_range_years <= 3 ~ "1 year",
  adf_range_years <= 10 ~ "2 years",
  TRUE ~ "5 years"
)
adf_label_format <- "%Y"

ADFTrend <- ggplot(ADF, aes(DateSold, .data[[target_price_col]])) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F, color = "red4", linewidth = 1,
              linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA), breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 5)) +
  scale_x_date(date_breaks = adf_break_interval, date_labels = adf_label_format) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme_point_colour() +
  labs(title = paste0("Overall Trend - Land Sale Price per ", unit_label),
       subtitle = "Assignment Data Frame (ADF)",
       x = "Sale Date",
       y = paste0("Sale Price per ", unit_label),
       caption = params$Company)
ADFTrend
```

### Price/`r unit_label` by Neighbourhood
```{r adf_neighbourhood_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("ADF - Price/", unit_label, "by Neighbourhood")

if ("Neighborhood" %in% names(ADF) && length(unique(ADF$Neighborhood[!is.na(ADF$Neighborhood) & ADF$Neighborhood != ""])) > 0) {
  .rollup <- rollup_neighbourhoods_for_boxplot(ADF, target_price_col, max_bars = 10)
  adf_nb        <- .rollup$df
  nb_stats      <- .rollup$stats
  nb_colors_adf <- .rollup$colors

  ggplot(adf_nb, aes(x = Neighborhood, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Neighborhood)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = nb_stats,
              aes(x = Neighborhood, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = nb_colors_adf) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Neighbourhood"),
      subtitle = "Assignment Data Frame (ADF)",
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No neighbourhood data available")
}
```

### Price/`r unit_label` by Zoning
```{r adf_zoning_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("ADF - Price/", unit_label, "by Zoning")

if ("Zoning" %in% names(ADF) && length(unique(ADF$Zoning[!is.na(ADF$Zoning) & ADF$Zoning != ""])) > 0) {
  adf_zn <- ADF %>%
    filter(!is.na(Zoning), Zoning != "")

  # Order zonings by median price (ascending so highest is at top after coord_flip)
  # Minimum 3 sales to include a zoning category
  zn_stats <- adf_zn %>%
    group_by(Zoning) %>%
    summarise(med = median(.data[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              q3 = quantile(.data[[target_price_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
              n = n()) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    arrange(med)

  adf_zn <- adf_zn %>% filter(Zoning %in% zn_stats$Zoning)

  # Create labelled factor: "Zoning (n)"
  zn_labels <- paste0(zn_stats$Zoning, " (", zn_stats$n, ")")
  adf_zn$Zoning <- factor(adf_zn$Zoning,
                          levels = zn_stats$Zoning,
                          labels = zn_labels)

  # Map zoning colors from the precomputed Set2 palette (keyed to original names)
  zn_colors_adf <- zoning_color_map[zn_stats$Zoning]

  # Annotation: median price positioned at Q3 (right edge of box)
  zn_stats$Zoning <- factor(zn_labels, levels = zn_labels)

  ggplot(adf_zn, aes(x = Zoning, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Zoning)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = zn_stats,
              aes(x = Zoning, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(zn_colors_adf, zn_labels)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Zoning"),
      subtitle = "Assignment Data Frame (ADF); Min. 3 sales per zoning",
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No zoning data available")
}
```

```{r cms_map_property_type, warning=FALSE}
    mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(Dimensions, crs = 4326)) %>%
    st_as_sf()

  # Add fill_color to spatial data
  if(nrow(CMS_spatial) > 0) {
    CMS_spatial$fill_color <- prop_color_map[CMS_spatial$PropMajor]
  }

  # Use precomputed sf with tooltip (fill_color already set in precompute)
  CMS1_sf <- CMS1_sf_base

  # Create match expression for categorical coloring by property type
  cms_proptype_match_expr <- match_expr(
    column = "PropMajor",
    values = names(prop_color_map),
    stops = unname(prop_color_map),
    default = "#808080"
  )

  # Build base map with boundaries and distance rings
  Map1CMS1 <- build_base_map(
    bounds = map_bbox_cms1,
    muni_bnd = muni_bnd_cms1, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_cms1,
    muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "cms_proptype",
    circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
    lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = TRUE
  ) |>
    add_property_markers(params)

  # Add polygons if spatial data exists
  if(nrow(CMS_spatial) > 0) {
    Map1CMS1 <- Map1CMS1 |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = "cms-polygons-fill",
        source = CMS_spatial,
        fill_color = get_column("fill_color"),
        fill_opacity = 0.3,
        popup = "popup"
      ) |>
      add_line_layer(
        id = "cms-polygons-outline",
        source = CMS_spatial,
        line_color = "black",
        line_width = 1
      )
  }

  # Filter legend to only property types present in CMS1
  cms1_prop_types <- unique(CMS1$PropMajor[!is.na(CMS1$PropMajor)])
  cms1_prop_color_map <- prop_color_map[names(prop_color_map) %in% cms1_prop_types]

  Map1CMS1 <- Map1CMS1 |>
    add_circle_layer(
      id = "cms-points",
      source = CMS1_sf,
      circle_color = cms_proptype_match_expr,
      circle_radius = circle_radius,
      circle_stroke_color = "black",
      circle_stroke_width = 1,
      circle_opacity = 0.7,
      tooltip = "tooltip",
      popup = "popup"
    ) |>
    add_legend(
      legend_title = "Property Type",
      values = sort(names(cms1_prop_color_map)),
      colors = unname(cms1_prop_color_map[sort(names(cms1_prop_color_map))]),
      type = "categorical",
      layer_id = "cms-points",
      interactive = TRUE,
      position = "bottom-right"
    )

  Map1CMS1
} else {
  empty_map()
}
```

```{r cms_map_zoning, warning=FALSE}
} else {
```

```{r map_cms_neighborhoods}
#| title: "CMS - Map by Neighbourhood"

  # Check if Neighborhood column exists
if("Neighborhood" %in% names(CMS1) && sum(!is.na(CMS1$Neighborhood)) > 0) {
  # Create neighbourhood color map using WRHA palette
  neighborhoods <- unique(CMS1$Neighborhood[!is.na(CMS1$Neighborhood)])
  neighborhood_colors <- get_nb_color(neighborhoods)
  neighborhood_color_map <- setNames(neighborhood_colors, neighborhoods)

  # Pre-compute colors (added to CMS1 which already has tooltip)
  CMS1$neighborhood_color <- neighborhood_color_map[CMS1$Neighborhood]

  # Create sf from updated CMS1 (neighborhood_color was just added, can't use CMS1_sf_base)
  CMS1_sf_n <- CMS1 %>%
    filter(!is.na(Lon) & !is.na(Lat) & !is.na(Neighborhood)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326)

  # Build base map with boundaries and distance rings (no muni boundaries)
  MapN <- build_base_map(
    bounds = map_bbox_cms1,
    muni_bnd = NULL, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_cms1,
    muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "cms_nb",
    circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
    lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = TRUE
  ) |>
    add_property_markers(params)

  # Create match expression for categorical coloring by neighbourhood
  cms_nb_match_expr <- match_expr(
    column = "Neighborhood",
    values = names(neighborhood_color_map),
    stops = unname(neighborhood_color_map),
    default = "#808080"
  )

  MapN <- MapN |>
    add_circle_layer(
      id = "neighborhood-points",
      source = CMS1_sf_n,
      circle_color = cms_nb_match_expr,
      circle_radius = circle_radius,
      circle_stroke_color = "black",
      circle_stroke_width = 1,
      circle_opacity = 0.7,
      tooltip = "tooltip",
      popup = "popup"
    ) |>
    add_legend(
      legend_title = "Neighbourhood",
      values = sort(names(neighborhood_color_map)),
      colors = unname(neighborhood_color_map[sort(names(neighborhood_color_map))]),
      type = "categorical",
      layer_id = "neighborhood-points",
      interactive = TRUE,
      position = "bottom-right"
    )

  MapN
} else {
  maplibre(
    center = c(circle_lon, circle_lat),
    zoom = 9
  ) |>
    add_navigation_control(position = "top-left")
}
```

```{r trend_price_over_time, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS - Price per", unit_label, "Over Time")

CMS1Trend <- ggplot(CMS1, aes(DateSold, .data[[target_price_col]])) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F,
              color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),

               labels = scales::date_format(date_label_format)) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme_point_colour() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Land Price per ", unit_label, " Over Time"),
    subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle1, 66),
    x = "Sale Date",
    y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
    caption = paste0("Daily Change: $", MktCondVal1,
                     "; Median Price/", unit_label, ": ", label_dollar(accuracy = price_accuracy)(MedianPriceUnit1),
                     "; ", label_percent(accuracy = .01)(AnnualIncreasePer1),

  )
```

### Price per `r unit_label` by Parcel Size
```{r size_price_by_size}
#| title: !expr paste("Price per", unit_label, "by Parcel Size")

# Adaptive x-axis precision and break count based on data range
cms1_size_range <- diff(range(CMS1[[target_size_col]], na.rm = TRUE))
x_accuracy1 <- dplyr::case_when(
  cms1_size_range < 10  ~ 0.01,
  cms1_size_range < 100 ~ 1,
  TRUE                  ~ size_accuracy
)
x_n_breaks1 <- dplyr::case_when(
  cms1_size_range < 1  ~ 5L,
  cms1_size_range < 10 ~ 7L,
  cms1_size_range < 50 ~ 8L,
  TRUE                 ~ 10L
)

# Predict price at subject lot size from linear model
size_lm1 <- lm(reformulate(target_size_col, target_price_col), data = CMS1)
size_pred1 <- predict(size_lm1, newdata = setNames(data.frame(sub_lot_size), target_size_col))

CMS1Size <- ggplot(CMS1, aes(.data[[target_size_col]], .data[[target_price_col]])) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F,
              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F,
              color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sub_lot_size), color = "dodgerblue2",
             linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = x_accuracy1, big.mark = ","),
                     breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = x_n_breaks1),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme_point_colour() +
  labs(
    title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Parcel Size"),
    subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle1, 66),
    x = paste0("Parcel Size (", unit_label_full, ")"),
    y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
    caption = paste0("Subject property: ", scales::number(sub_lot_size, accuracy = x_accuracy1, big.mark = ","), " ", unit_label,
                     " (blue line); Trend value: ", label_dollar(accuracy = price_accuracy)(size_pred1),
                     "/", unit_label, " | ", params$Company)
  )
```

### Price/`r unit_label` by Neighbourhood
```{r cms1_neighbourhood_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS - Price/", unit_label, "by Neighbourhood")

if ("Neighborhood" %in% names(CMS1) && nrow(CMS1) > 0 &&
    length(unique(CMS1$Neighborhood[!is.na(CMS1$Neighborhood) & CMS1$Neighborhood != ""])) > 0) {
  .rollup <- rollup_neighbourhoods_for_boxplot(CMS1, target_price_col, max_bars = 10)
  cms1_nb        <- .rollup$df
  nb_stats1      <- .rollup$stats
  nb_colors_cms1 <- .rollup$colors

  ggplot(cms1_nb, aes(x = Neighborhood, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Neighborhood)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = nb_stats1,
              aes(x = Neighborhood, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = nb_colors_cms1) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Neighbourhood"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle1, 80),
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No neighbourhood data available in CMS")
}
```

### Price/`r unit_label` by Zoning
```{r cms1_zoning_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS - Price/", unit_label, "by Zoning")

if ("Zoning" %in% names(CMS1) && nrow(CMS1) > 0 &&
    length(unique(CMS1$Zoning[!is.na(CMS1$Zoning) & CMS1$Zoning != ""])) > 0) {
  cms1_zn <- CMS1 %>%
    filter(!is.na(Zoning), Zoning != "")

  zn_stats1 <- cms1_zn %>%
    group_by(Zoning) %>%
    summarise(med = median(.data[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              q3 = quantile(.data[[target_price_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
              n = n()) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    arrange(med)

  cms1_zn <- cms1_zn %>% filter(Zoning %in% zn_stats1$Zoning)

  zn_labels1 <- paste0(zn_stats1$Zoning, " (", zn_stats1$n, ")")
  cms1_zn$Zoning <- factor(cms1_zn$Zoning,
                           levels = zn_stats1$Zoning,
                           labels = zn_labels1)

  zn_colors_cms1 <- zoning_color_map[zn_stats1$Zoning]
  zn_stats1$Zoning <- factor(zn_labels1, levels = zn_labels1)

  ggplot(cms1_zn, aes(x = Zoning, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Zoning)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = zn_stats1,
              aes(x = Zoning, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(zn_colors_cms1, zn_labels1)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Zoning"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(paste0(Subtitle1, "; Min. 3 sales per zoning"), 80),
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No zoning data available in CMS")
}
```

### Heatmap - Price/`r unit_label` & Property Type
```{r map_cms2_heatmap}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS2 Heatmap - Price/", unit_label, "(5th-95th Percentile)")

if (nrow(CMS2) > 0) {
  # Use precomputed sf with tooltip (filter for non-NA price)
  CMS2_sf <- CMS2_sf_base %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[target_price_col]]))

  if (nrow(CMS2_sf) > 0) {
    # Discrete quantile color scale (5 buckets with rounded values)
    cms2_price_scale <- create_quantile_classification(
      data = CMS2_sf,
      column = target_price_col,
      n = 5
    )

    # Assign each point to a price bucket for categorical legend interactivity
    cms2_buckets <- assign_buckets(
      data = CMS2_sf,
      column = target_price_col,
      classification = cms2_price_scale,
      label_formatter = function(breaks) format_price_bucket_labels(cms2_price_scale, unit_label, kind = "unit_price")
    )
    CMS2_sf$price_bucket <- cms2_buckets$bucket_col

    # Create match expression for categorical coloring
    cms2_price_match_expr <- match_expr(
      column = "price_bucket",
      values = cms2_buckets$labels,
      stops = unname(cms2_buckets$color_map),
      default = "#808080"
    )

    # Build base map with boundaries and distance rings
    Map1CMS2H <- build_base_map(
      bounds = map_bbox_cms2,
      muni_bnd = muni_bnd_cms2, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_cms2,
      muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "cms2_heatmap",
      circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
      lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = TRUE
    )

    # Add data layer and categorical legend (click legend items to show/hide)
    Map1CMS2H <- Map1CMS2H |>
      add_circle_layer(
        id = "cms2-heatmap",
        source = CMS2_sf,
        circle_color = cms2_price_match_expr,
        circle_radius = circle_radius,
        circle_stroke_color = "black",
        circle_stroke_width = 1,
        circle_opacity = 0.8,
        tooltip = "tooltip",
        popup = "popup"
      ) |>
      add_property_markers(params) |>
      add_legend(
        legend_title = paste0("Sale Price/", unit_label),
        values = cms2_buckets$labels,
        colors = unname(cms2_buckets$color_map),
        type = "categorical",
        layer_id = "cms2-heatmap",
        interactive = TRUE,
        position = "bottom-right"
      )

    Map1CMS2H
  } else {
    empty_map()
  }
} else {
  empty_map()
}
```

```{r cms2_map_property_type, warning=FALSE}
#| title: "CMS2 - Comparable Market Set by Property Type"

if (nrow(CMS2) > 0) {
  # Create spatial version if Dimensions exist
  CMS2_spatial <- CMS2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(Dimensions) & Dimensions != "") %>%
    mutate(geometry = st_as_sfc(Dimensions, crs = 4326)) %>%
    st_as_sf()

  # Add fill_color to spatial data
  if (nrow(CMS2_spatial) > 0) {
    CMS2_spatial$fill_color <- prop_color_map[CMS2_spatial$PropMajor]
  }

  # Use precomputed sf with tooltip (fill_color already set in precompute)
  CMS2_sf <- CMS2_sf_base

  # Create match expression for categorical coloring by property type
  cms2_proptype_match_expr <- match_expr(
    column = "PropMajor",
    values = names(prop_color_map),
    stops = unname(prop_color_map),
    default = "#808080"
  )

  # Build base map with boundaries and distance rings
  Map1CMS2PropType <- build_base_map(
    bounds = map_bbox_cms2,
    muni_bnd = muni_bnd_cms2, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_cms2,
    muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "cms2_proptype",
    circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
    lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = TRUE
  ) |>
    add_property_markers(params)

  # Add polygons if spatial data exists
  if (nrow(CMS2_spatial) > 0) {
    Map1CMS2PropType <- Map1CMS2PropType |>
      add_fill_layer(
        id = "cms2-polygons-fill",
        source = CMS2_spatial,
        fill_color = get_column("fill_color"),
        fill_opacity = 0.3,
        popup = "popup"
      ) |>
      add_line_layer(
        id = "cms2-polygons-outline",
        source = CMS2_spatial,
        line_color = "black",
        line_width = 1
      )
  }

  # Filter legend to only property types present in CMS2
  cms2_prop_types <- unique(CMS2$PropMajor[!is.na(CMS2$PropMajor)])
  cms2_prop_color_map <- prop_color_map[names(prop_color_map) %in% cms2_prop_types]

  Map1CMS2PropType <- Map1CMS2PropType |>
    add_circle_layer(
      id = "cms2-points",
      source = CMS2_sf,
      circle_color = cms2_proptype_match_expr,
      circle_radius = circle_radius,
      circle_stroke_color = "black",
      circle_stroke_width = 1,
      circle_opacity = 0.7,
      tooltip = "tooltip",
      popup = "popup"
    ) |>
    add_legend(
      legend_title = "Property Type",
      values = sort(names(cms2_prop_color_map)),
      colors = unname(cms2_prop_color_map[sort(names(cms2_prop_color_map))]),
      type = "categorical",
      layer_id = "cms2-points",
      interactive = TRUE,
      position = "bottom-right"
    )

  Map1CMS2PropType
} else {

}
```

```{r map_cms2_neighborhoods}

if ("Neighborhood" %in% names(CMS2) && sum(!is.na(CMS2$Neighborhood)) > 0) {

  # Create sf from updated CMS2
  CMS2_sf_n <- CMS2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(Lon) & !is.na(Lat) & !is.na(Neighborhood)) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326)

  # Create match expression for categorical coloring by neighbourhood
  cms2_nb_match_expr <- match_expr(
    column = "Neighborhood",
    values = names(neighborhood_color_map),

      position = "bottom-right"
    )

  Map2CMS2N
} else {

}
```
