### Price per `r unit_label` by Parcel Size
```{r size_price_by_size_cms2}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS2 Price per", unit_label, "by Parcel Size")

if (nrow(CMS2) > 1) {
  # Adaptive x-axis precision and break count based on data range
  cms2_size_range <- diff(range(CMS2[[target_size_col]], na.rm = TRUE))
  x_accuracy2 <- dplyr::case_when(
    cms2_size_range < 10  ~ 0.01,
    cms2_size_range < 100 ~ 1,
    TRUE                  ~ size_accuracy
  )
  x_n_breaks2 <- dplyr::case_when(
    cms2_size_range < 1  ~ 5L,
    cms2_size_range < 10 ~ 7L,
    cms2_size_range < 50 ~ 8L,
    TRUE                 ~ 10L
  )

  # Predict price at subject lot size from linear model
  size_lm2 <- lm(reformulate(target_size_col, target_price_col), data = CMS2)
  size_pred2 <- predict(size_lm2, newdata = setNames(data.frame(sub_lot_size), target_size_col))

  CMS2Size <- ggplot(CMS2, aes(.data[[target_size_col]], .data[[target_price_col]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F,
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F,
                color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = sub_lot_size), color = "dodgerblue2",
               linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 7),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = x_accuracy2, big.mark = ","),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = x_n_breaks2),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    theme_custom() +
    theme_point_colour() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Parcel Size"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle3, 66),
      x = paste0("Parcel Size (", unit_label_full, ")"),
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = paste0("Subject property: ", scales::number(sub_lot_size, accuracy = x_accuracy2, big.mark = ","), " ", unit_label,
                       " (blue line); Trend value: ", label_dollar(accuracy = price_accuracy)(size_pred2),
                       "/", unit_label, " | ", params$Company)
    )
  CMS2Size
} else {
  empty_chart("Insufficient CMS2 data for parcel-size chart")
}
```

### Price per `r unit_label` by Distance
```{r dist_price_by_distance_cms2}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS2 Price per", unit_label, "by Distance")

if (nrow(CMS2) > 1) {
  # Select distance column and label based on SubRef setting
  dist_col <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") "RefDist" else "SubDist"
  dist_label <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") params$RefPoint else "subject"
  dist_vline <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") Subject$RefDist else Subject$SubDist

  # Predict price at vline distance from linear model
  dist_lm2 <- lm(reformulate(dist_col, target_price_col), data = CMS2)
  dist_pred2 <- predict(dist_lm2, newdata = setNames(data.frame(dist_vline), dist_col))
  dist_adj_lm2 <- lm(reformulate(dist_col, "AdjPrice"), data = CMS2)
  dist_adj_pred2 <- predict(dist_adj_lm2, newdata = setNames(data.frame(dist_vline), dist_col))

  CMS2Dist <- ggplot(CMS2, aes(.data[[dist_col]], .data[[target_price_col]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F,
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F,
                color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    {if (params$SubRef == "Ref") geom_vline(aes(xintercept = dist_vline), color = "dodgerblue2",
               linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed")} +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    theme_custom() +
    theme_point_colour() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Distance from ", dist_label),
      subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle3, 66),
      x = paste0("Distance from ", dist_label, " (km)"),
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = if (params$SubRef == "Ref") paste0("Subject property distance: ", dist_vline, " km; Trend value: ", label_dollar(accuracy = price_accuracy)(dist_pred2), "/", unit_label, " | ", params$Company) else paste0("Trend value at subject: ", label_dollar(accuracy = price_accuracy)(dist_pred2), "/", unit_label, " | ", params$Company)
    )
  CMS2Dist
} else {
  empty_chart("Insufficient CMS2 data for distance chart")
}
```

### Price/`r unit_label` by Neighbourhood
```{r cms2_neighbourhood_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS2 - Price/", unit_label, "by Neighbourhood")

if ("Neighborhood" %in% names(CMS2) && nrow(CMS2) > 0 &&
    length(unique(CMS2$Neighborhood[!is.na(CMS2$Neighborhood) & CMS2$Neighborhood != ""])) > 0) {
  .rollup <- rollup_neighbourhoods_for_boxplot(CMS2, target_price_col, max_bars = 10)
  cms2_nb        <- .rollup$df
  nb_stats2      <- .rollup$stats
  nb_colors_cms2 <- .rollup$colors

  ggplot(cms2_nb, aes(x = Neighborhood, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Neighborhood)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = nb_stats2,
              aes(x = Neighborhood, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = nb_colors_cms2) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Neighbourhood"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(Subtitle3, 80),
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No neighbourhood data available in CMS2")
}
```

```{r cms2_zoning_boxplot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#| title: !expr paste("CMS2 - Price/", unit_label, "by Zoning")

if ("Zoning" %in% names(CMS2) && nrow(CMS2) > 0 &&
    length(unique(CMS2$Zoning[!is.na(CMS2$Zoning) & CMS2$Zoning != ""])) > 0) {
  cms2_zn <- CMS2 %>%
    filter(!is.na(Zoning), Zoning != "")

  zn_stats2 <- cms2_zn %>%
    group_by(Zoning) %>%
    summarise(med = median(.data[[target_price_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
              q3 = quantile(.data[[target_price_col]], 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
              n = n()) %>%
    filter(n >= 3) %>%
    arrange(med)

  cms2_zn <- cms2_zn %>% filter(Zoning %in% zn_stats2$Zoning)

  zn_labels2 <- paste0(zn_stats2$Zoning, " (", zn_stats2$n, ")")
  cms2_zn$Zoning <- factor(cms2_zn$Zoning,
                           levels = zn_stats2$Zoning,
                           labels = zn_labels2)

  zn_colors_cms2 <- zoning_color_map[zn_stats2$Zoning]
  zn_stats2$Zoning <- factor(zn_labels2, levels = zn_labels2)

  ggplot(cms2_zn, aes(x = Zoning, y = .data[[target_price_col]], fill = Zoning)) +
    geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.6, color = "steelblue4",
                 outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "red4", outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.15, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.4, color = "steelblue4") +
    geom_text(data = zn_stats2,
              aes(x = Zoning, y = q3, label = dollar(med, accuracy = price_accuracy)),
              hjust = -0.15, vjust = -0.7, size = 3.5, color = "grey30", fontface = "italic",
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = setNames(zn_colors_cms2, zn_labels2)) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.18))) +
    coord_flip() +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9),
          legend.position = "none") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Zoning"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(paste0(Subtitle3, "; Min. 3 sales per zoning"), 80),
      x = NULL,
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = params$Company
    )
} else {
  empty_chart("No zoning data available in CMS2")
}
```

`r if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") '### Heatmap - Price/Land Unit'`
```{r map_cms_heatmap_lu}
#| eval: !expr params$PricePerUnit == "Y" && nrow(CMSLU) > 0
# Heatmap of CMSLU sales colored by quantile bucket of price per land unit.

# Guard for interactive execution
if(nrow(CMSLU) > 0 && "Lon" %in% names(CMSLU)) {

# Create sf version with tooltip
CMSLU_sf <- CMSLU %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lon) & !is.na(Lat) & !is.na(PriceLandUnit)) %>%
  mutate(tooltip = paste0(
    Address, ", ", City,
    "<br>Date: ", format(DateSold, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    "<br>Price: ", scales::dollar(PriceSold, accuracy = 1),
    "<br>Land Units: ", LandUnits,
    "<br>$/Unit: ", scales::dollar(PriceLandUnit, accuracy = 1),
    "<br>Zoning: ", Zoning
  )) %>%
  st_as_sf(coords = c("Lon", "Lat"), crs = 4326)

# Discrete quantile color scale (5 buckets with rounded values)
cmslu_price_scale <- create_quantile_classification(
  data = CMSLU_sf,
  column = "PriceLandUnit",
  n = 5
)

# Assign each point to a price bucket for categorical legend interactivity
cmslu_buckets <- assign_buckets(
  data = CMSLU_sf,
  column = "PriceLandUnit",
  classification = cmslu_price_scale,
  label_formatter = function(breaks) format_price_bucket_labels(cmslu_price_scale, "Unit", kind = "unit_price")
)
CMSLU_sf$price_bucket <- cmslu_buckets$bucket_col

# Create match expression for categorical coloring
cmslu_price_match_expr <- match_expr(
  column = "price_bucket",
  values = cmslu_buckets$labels,
  stops = unname(cmslu_buckets$color_map),
  default = "#808080"
)

# Get and prepare municipal boundaries for CMSLU
muni_bnd_cmslu <- prep_muni_bnd(get_filtered_muni_boundaries(CMSLU), muni_color_map)

# Get and prepare Winnipeg neighbourhood boundaries (if available)
wpg_nb_bnd_cmslu <- prep_wpg_nb_bnd(get_filtered_wpg_nb_boundaries(CMSLU))

# Compute bbox for CMSLU (conditionally created)
map_bbox_cmslu <- compute_map_bounds(CMSLU_sf, params, radius_km = params$HiDistKM)

# Build base map with boundaries and distance rings
Map1CMSHLU <- build_base_map(
  bounds = map_bbox_cmslu,
  muni_bnd = muni_bnd_cmslu, wpg_nb_bnd = wpg_nb_bnd_cmslu,
  muni_color_map = muni_color_map, id_prefix = "cmslu_heatmap",
  circle_lon = circle_lon, circle_lat = circle_lat,
  lo_km = params$LoDistKM, hi_km = params$HiDistKM, show_rings = TRUE
)

# Add data layer and categorical legend (click legend items to show/hide)
Map1CMSHLU <- Map1CMSHLU |>
  add_circle_layer(
    id = "cms-heatmap-lu",
    source = CMSLU_sf,
    circle_color = cmslu_price_match_expr,
    circle_radius = circle_radius,
    circle_stroke_color = "black",
    circle_stroke_width = 1,
    circle_opacity = 0.8,
    tooltip = "tooltip",
    popup = "popup"
  ) |>
  add_property_markers(params) |>
  add_legend(
    legend_title = "Sale Price/Land Unit",
    values = cmslu_buckets$labels,
    colors = unname(cmslu_buckets$color_map),
    type = "categorical",
    layer_id = "cms-heatmap-lu",
    interactive = TRUE,
    position = "bottom-right"
  )

Map1CMSHLU
} # End guard
```

```{r trend_price_over_time_lu, warning=FALSE}
# Static trend chart: price per land unit over time.

              color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +

    title = "Land Price per Land Unit Over Time",
```

`r if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") paste0('### Price per ', unit_label, ' by Density')`
```{r plot_density_cmslu}
#| title: !expr paste("Price per", unit_label, "by Density (Units/Acre)")
#| eval: !expr params$PricePerUnit == "Y"

# Initialize as NULL so the export chunk doesn't crash
CMSLUDens1 <- NULL

# Perform the check: Column exists AND has enough valid data pairs
if (params$PricePerUnit == "Y" &&
    "DUAcre" %in% names(CMSLU) &&
    target_price_col %in% names(CMSLU) &&
    sum(!is.na(CMSLU$DUAcre) & !is.na(CMSLU[[target_price_col]])) > 2) {

  # 1. Fit the linear model on CMSLU (multi-family filtered set) using the
  #    AcOrSF-selected price column.
  fit_lu <- lm(reformulate("DUAcre", target_price_col), data = CMSLU)

  # 2. Calculate predicted price at subject density
  price_lu_raw <- predict(fit_lu, newdata = data.frame(DUAcre = SubLandUnitDensity1))
  # Round to thousands for $/Acre, to cents for $/SF
  price_lu_rounded <- if (params$AcOrSF == "sf") round(price_lu_raw, 2) else round(price_lu_raw, -3)

  intersection_text_lu <- paste0("Intersection (blue line) @ ",
                                 scales::dollar(price_lu_rounded, accuracy = price_accuracy))

  # 3. Create the plot object
  CMSLUDens1 <- ggplot(CMSLU, aes(DUAcre, .data[[target_price_col]])) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F, color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = label_dollar(), limits = c(0, NA), breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 5)) +
    scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA), breaks = breaks_pretty(n = 6)) +
    geom_vline(aes(xintercept = SubLandUnitDensity1), color = "dodgerblue2", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_custom() +
    theme_point_colour() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per ", unit_label, " by Density"),
      subtitle = str_wrap(SubtitleLU1, 66),
      x = "Land Units per Acre (Density)",
      y = paste0("Price per ", unit_label),
      caption = paste0(intersection_text_lu, " | ", params$Company)
    )

  # Display the plot in the dashboard
  CMSLUDens1

} else {
  # If data is missing, show a placeholder so the dashboard doesn't look broken
  cat("Insufficient density data available for this comparable set.")
}
```

`r if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") '### Density by Zoning'`
```{r plot_density_by_zoning_cmslu}
#| title: "Density (Units/Acre) by Zoning"
#| eval: !expr params$PricePerUnit == "Y"

# Boxplot of actual built density (DUAcre) grouped by Zoning, drawn from CMSLU.
# Goal: surface the typical units-per-acre that has been built within each
# zoning designation in the comparable set.

CMSLUDensZone <- NULL

if (params$PricePerUnit == "Y" &&
    "DUAcre" %in% names(CMSLU) &&
    "Zoning" %in% names(CMSLU) &&
    sum(!is.na(CMSLU$DUAcre) & !is.na(CMSLU$Zoning) & nzchar(CMSLU$Zoning)) > 0) {

  # Order zonings on the x-axis by median density (ascending) for readability
  CMSLUDensZoneData <- CMSLU %>%
    filter(!is.na(DUAcre), !is.na(Zoning), nzchar(Zoning)) %>%
    mutate(Zoning = forcats::fct_reorder(Zoning, DUAcre, .fun = median, .na_rm = TRUE))

  # Per-zoning summary used for the in-chart annotations placed just above the x-axis
  zone_stats <- CMSLUDensZoneData %>%
    group_by(Zoning) %>%
    summarise(
      n = dplyr::n(),
      med = median(DUAcre, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(label = paste0("n=", n, "\nmed=", round(med, 1)))

  CMSLUDensZone <- ggplot(CMSLUDensZoneData, aes(x = Zoning, y = DUAcre)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue1", color = "steelblue4",
                 alpha = 0.6, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.18, height = 0, shape = 21, size = 2,
                fill = "steelblue1", color = "steelblue4",
                alpha = 0.7, stroke = 0.4) +
    geom_hline(aes(yintercept = SubLandUnitDensity1),
               color = "dodgerblue2", linewidth = 1.2, linetype = "dashed") +
    annotate("label", x = Inf, y = SubLandUnitDensity1,
             label = paste0("Subject: ", SubLandUnitDensity1, " u/ac"),
             color = "dodgerblue2", fill = "white", fontface = "bold",
             hjust = 1.05, vjust = -0.3, label.size = 0.4) +
    geom_text(data = zone_stats,
              aes(x = Zoning, y = 0, label = label),
              vjust = -0.1, size = 2.9, color = "gray25",
              lineheight = 0.85, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.08, 0.08))) +
    theme_custom() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5)) +
    labs(
      title = "Built Density by Zoning",
      subtitle = str_wrap(
        sub("^CMS", "CMS (NOTE: some parcels re-zoned after the land sale)", SubtitleLU1),
        80
      ),
      x = "Zoning",
      y = "Land Units per Acre (Density)",
      caption = params$Company
    )

  CMSLUDensZone

} else {
  cat("Insufficient density-by-zoning data available for this comparable set.")
}
```

```{r dist_price_by_distance_lu}
#| title: "Price per Land Unit by Distance"
#| eval: !expr params$PricePerUnit == "Y"

# Price per Land Unit vs distance from RefPoint (or subject), drawn from CMSLU.
# Mirrors dist_price_by_distance on CMS Maps & Trends but plots PriceLandUnit
# from the multi-family-filtered set.

CMSLUDist <- NULL

if (params$PricePerUnit == "Y" &&
    nrow(CMSLU) > 2 &&
    "PriceLandUnit" %in% names(CMSLU)) {

  # Switchboard - same pattern as the CMS1 distance chart
  dist_col_lu <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") "RefDist" else "SubDist"
  dist_label_lu <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") params$RefPoint else "subject"
  dist_vline_lu <- if (params$SubRef == "Ref") Subject$RefDist else Subject$SubDist

  # Linear-fit prediction at the subject distance for the caption
  dist_lm_lu <- lm(reformulate(dist_col_lu, "PriceLandUnit"), data = CMSLU)
  dist_pred_lu <- predict(dist_lm_lu, newdata = setNames(data.frame(dist_vline_lu), dist_col_lu))

  CMSLUDist <- ggplot(CMSLU, aes(.data[[dist_col_lu]], PriceLandUnit)) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,1), se = F,
                color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ poly(x,3), se = F,
                color = "red4", linewidth = 1, linetype = "dashed") +
    {if (params$SubRef == "Ref") geom_vline(aes(xintercept = dist_vline_lu),
       color = "dodgerblue2", linewidth = 1.5, linetype = "dashed")} +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = dollar, limits = c(0, NA),
                       breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 6),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.005, 0.05))) +
    theme_custom() +
    theme_point_colour() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Price per Land Unit by Distance from ", dist_label_lu),
      subtitle = str_wrap(SubtitleLU1, 66),
      x = paste0("Distance from ", dist_label_lu, " (km)"),
      y = "Price per Land Unit",
      caption = if (params$SubRef == "Ref") {
        paste0("Subject distance: ", dist_vline_lu, " km; Trend value: ",
               label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(dist_pred_lu), "/Unit | ", params$Company)
      } else {
        paste0("Trend value at subject: ", label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(dist_pred_lu),
               "/Unit | ", params$Company)
      }
    )

  CMSLUDist

} else {
  cat("Insufficient distance data available for this comparable set.")
}
```

```{r exposure_histogram}
#| eval: !expr params$ExposureCharts == "Y"
# Histogram of days-on-market for ADF vs CMS sales in the exposure price band.

if(params$ExposureCharts == "Y") {
# Creates a histogram of Exposure Times for ADF and CMS1

ADF_ExpStats <- summary(ADF_Exp$DOM, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75), na.rm = FALSE)

Exp25 <- ADF_ExpStats[2]
Exp50 <- ADF_ExpStats[3]

ExpHist <-

  geom_histogram(data = ADF_Exp, aes(DOM_capped), color = "black", fill = "steelblue2", alpha=0.7, breaks = seq(0,1170,90)) +
  geom_histogram(data = CMS_Exp, aes(DOM_capped), color = "black", fill = "steelblue4", alpha=0.7, breaks = seq(0,1170,90)) +
  theme_custom() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 2), plot.subtitle = element_markdown(), legend.position = "none") +
  labs(title = "Exposure Times - Days on Market (DOM)",
       subtitle = paste0(format(LoDate, "%b-%Y")," to ", format(HiDate, "%b-%Y"),"; Price: ", label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(params$ExposurePriceMin),"-", label_dollar(accuracy = 1)(params$ExposurePriceMax),"; ",subtitle_hist2),
       x = "DOM - 90 day brackets; 1080-1170 bracket includes >1170 days",
       y = "Number of Sales",
       caption = paste("ADF Stats - 25th:", Exp25, "days; Median:", Exp50, "days; 75th:", Exp75,"days | ", params$Company))+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=seq(0,1170,90))+
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(0, ceiling(max(x)), by = max(1, round(max(x)/5))))
ExpHist
}
```

```{r cms_datatable, warning=FALSE}
#| title: "Interactive Comparable Search"

# 1. Prepare display data (keeping your mutation logic for sorting)
table_data <- CMS1 %>%
  select(
    Address, City, Municipality, DateSold, PriceSold,
    LandSF, PriceLandSF, Acres, PriceAcre, Zoning, SubDist, RefDist, TaxID, N1ID
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    DateSold = format(DateSold, "%b-%Y"),
    Acres = scales::comma(Acres, accuracy = .01),
    LandSF = scales::comma(LandSF, accuracy = 1),
    PriceSold = scales::dollar(PriceSold, accuracy = 1),
    PriceLandSF = scales::dollar(PriceLandSF, accuracy = .01),
    PriceAcre = scales::dollar(PriceAcre, accuracy = 1),
    SubDist = paste0(SubDist, " km"),
    RefDist = paste0(RefDist, " km")
  )

# Define clean headers for the data table
clean_headers <- c(
  "Address", "City", "Municipality", "Sale Date", "Price",
  "Land SF", "$/SF", "Acres", "$/Acre", "Zoning",
  "Dist (Sub)", "Dist (Ref)", "Tax ID", "N1ID"
)

DT::datatable(
  table_data,
  colnames = clean_headers,
  class = "cell-border stripe hover",
  options = list(
    pageLength = 20,
    scrollX = TRUE,
    columnDefs = list(
      list(className = "dt-center", targets = 3:11),  # DateSold..RefDist
      list(width = "200px", targets = 0),             # Address
      list(width = "100px", targets = 1),             # City
      list(width = "70px",  targets = 6),             # Acres (shrink)
      list(
        width = "90px",
        targets = 12,                                 # TaxID (correct)
        render = DT::JS(
          "function(data, type, row) {",
          "  return type === 'display' ? ",
          "    '<div style=\"white-space: normal; width: 90px; font-size: 0.85em;\">' + data + '</div>' : data;",
          "}"
        )
      )
    )
  ),
  rownames = FALSE,
  filter = "top"
)
```

```{r outlier_notes}
#| output: asis
# Display excluded outliers with reasons (only if any outliers were specified)
if(nrow(CMSOutliers) > 0 && any(CMSOutliers$N1ID != "")) {
  # Look up property details from ADF for each outlier
  outlier_details <- ADF %>%
    mutate(N1ID = as.character(N1ID)) %>%
    filter(N1ID %in% CMSOutliers$N1ID) %>%
    select(N1ID, Address, City, PriceSold, Acres) %>%
    left_join(CMSOutliers, by = "N1ID") %>%
    mutate(
      PriceSold = scales::dollar(PriceSold, accuracy = 1),
      Acres = scales::comma(Acres, accuracy = 0.01)
    )

  cat("**Excluded Records:**\n\n")
  for(i in seq_len(nrow(outlier_details))) {
    row <- outlier_details[i, ]
    reason_text <- if(!is.na(row$Reason) && row$Reason != "") paste0(" — *", row$Reason, "*") else ""
    cat(paste0("- **N1ID ", row$N1ID, "**: ", row$Address, ", ", row$City,
               " (", row$PriceSold, "; ", row$Acres, " ac)", reason_text, "\n"))
  }
} else {
  cat("No records excluded.\n")
}
```

### Export Charts {.hidden}

```{r export_charts, include=FALSE}
# Export charts and maps to ./charts/ directory
if (params$ExportCharts == "Y") {

  # 1. Create directory safely
  if (!dir.exists("./charts")) {
    dir.create("./charts", recursive = TRUE)
  }

  cat("Exporting charts to ./charts/ directory...\n\n")

  # 2. Refined Helper Function
  smart_save <- function(plot_obj_name, filename, w = 6.5, h = 3.5) {
    # Specify inherits = TRUE to look outside the function's local scope
    if (exists(plot_obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
      ggsave(paste0("./charts/", filename), get(plot_obj_name),
             width = w, height = h, units = "in", dpi = 300)
      cat(paste0("  Saved: ", filename, "\n"))
    } else {
      cat(paste0("  Skipped: ", plot_obj_name, " (Object not found)\n"))
    }
  }

  # ============ EXPORT CMS CHARTS ============
  # Filename suffix based on AcOrSF parameter
  unit_suffix <- if(params$AcOrSF == "ac") "Ac" else "SF"

  smart_save("CMS1Trend", paste0("CMS1_Trend", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS1Size", paste0("CMS1_Size", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS1SizeAdj", paste0("CMS1_SizeAdj", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS1Dist", paste0("CMS1_Dist", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS1DistAdj", paste0("CMS1_DistAdj", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS2Trend", paste0("CMS2_Trend", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS2Size", paste0("CMS2_Size", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS2SizeAdj", paste0("CMS2_SizeAdj", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS2Dist", paste0("CMS2_Dist", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_save("CMS2DistAdj", paste0("CMS2_DistAdj", unit_suffix, ".png"))

  # ============ MULTIFAMILY EXPORTS (LU) ============
  if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") {
    smart_save("CMSLUTrend", "CMS_Trend_LU.png")
    smart_save("CMSLUDens1", "CMS_Density_LU_Nominal.png")
    smart_save("CMSLUDens2", "CMS_Density_LU_Adjusted.png")
  }
  
  # ============ EXPOSURE CHARTS (Safety added) ============
  # Added exists("CMS_Exp") to prevent crash
  if(params$ExposureCharts == "Y" && exists("CMS_Exp") && nrow(CMS_Exp) > 2) {
    smart_save("ExpHist", "Exposure_Histogram.png")
    smart_save("ExpDiscount", "Exposure_Discount.png")
    smart_save("ExpDOMPrice", "Exposure_DOMPrice.png")
  }

  # ============ FEATURE IMPORTANCE EXPORTS ============
  if(params$FeatureImportance == "Y") {
    cat("\n--- Exporting Feature Importance Charts ---\n")
    smart_save("fi_price", paste0("FI_Price_", unit_label, ".png"))
  }

  # ============ MAP EXPORTS ============
  cat("\nExporting maps (this may take a moment)...\n")

  # Helper function for mapgl maps using mapgl::save_map() (requires chromote + Chrome)
  smart_map_save <- function(map_obj_name, filename, width = 900, height = 500) {
    if(exists(map_obj_name, inherits = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        mapgl::save_map(
          map = get(map_obj_name),
          filename = paste0("./charts/", filename),
          width = width,
          height = height,
          include_legend = TRUE,
          hide_controls = TRUE,
          include_scale_bar = TRUE,
          image_scale = 1.5
        )
        cat(paste0("  Saved: ", filename, "\n"))
      }, error = function(e) {
        cat(paste0("  Error saving ", filename, ": ", e$message, "\n"))
      })
    } else {
      cat(paste0("  Skipped: ", map_obj_name, " (Object not found)\n"))
    }
  }

  # Multifamily Map
  if(params$PricePerUnit == "Y") {
    smart_map_save("Map1CMSHLU", "Map_CMS_HeatmapLU.png")
  }

  # Heatmaps - filename suffix based on AcOrSF parameter
  #smart_map_save("Map1ADFH", paste0("Map_ADF_Heatmap", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_map_save("Map1CMSH", paste0("Map_CMS_Heatmap", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  smart_map_save("Map1CMS2H", paste0("Map_CMS2_Heatmap", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  #smart_map_save("Map1CMS2PropType", paste0("Map_CMS2_PropertyType", unit_suffix, ".png"))
  #smart_map_save("Map2CMS2N", paste0("Map_CMS2_Neighbourhood", unit_suffix, ".png"))

  cat("\n========================================\n")
  cat("EXPORT COMPLETE!\n")
  cat("========================================\n")
}
```

```{r export_cms, include=FALSE}
openxlsx::write.xlsx(CMS1, "./CMS1_export.xlsx")
```
